useCases.value: SD-WAN edge routers running high CPU or memory can drop packets, fail to establish tunnels, or crash. Monitoring device resources prevents silent performance degradation at remote sites where physical access is limited.

useCases.title: Firmware Version Compliance
useCases.value: Running inconsistent or outdated software versions across the SD-WAN fabric creates security vulnerabilities and feature gaps. Compliance dashboards accelerate upgrade planning and audit readiness.

useCases.title: DPI Application Visibility
useCases.value: Deep Packet Inspection on SD-WAN edges classifies traffic by application. Visibility into top applications per site drives policy tuning, bandwidth planning, and identification of shadow IT or unauthorized SaaS usage.

useCases.title: Cloud OnRamp Performance
useCases.value: Cloud OnRamp probes SaaS and IaaS endpoints from each site to select the best path. Monitoring probe results reveals when cloud application performance degrades before users open tickets, and validates that SD-WAN is actually improving cloud access.

useCases.title: Security Policy Violations (UTD)
useCases.value: SD-WAN edges running Unified Threat Defense (UTD) perform IPS, URL filtering, and AMP inline. Monitoring these events at the WAN edge catches threats that bypass centralized firewalls, especially for direct internet access (DIA) traffic that never traverses the data center.

useCases.title: vManage Cluster Health
useCases.value: vManage is the single management plane for the entire SD-WAN fabric. If the vManage cluster is unhealthy — high CPU, disk full, database replication lag, or services down — operators lose visibility and policy push capability across all sites.

useCases.title: Transport Circuit SLA Tracking
useCases.value: ISPs commit to contractual SLAs for latency, jitter, loss, and uptime per circuit. SD-WAN BFD metrics provide continuous proof of whether carriers meet their commitments. SLA violation evidence supports service credits and carrier negotiations.

useCases.title: Hub-and-Spoke vs Full-Mesh Topology Validation
useCases.value: SD-WAN overlay topology determines traffic flow patterns. Validating that the actual tunnel mesh matches the intended design prevents asymmetric routing, hairpinning through hubs, and suboptimal site-to-site paths that add latency and waste hub bandwidth.

useCases.title: VMware VeloCloud Orchestrator Tunnel Health
useCases.value: VMware SD-WAN (VeloCloud) is widely deployed for branch/WAN connectivity. Monitoring tunnel status, latency, and jitter from the VeloCloud Orchestrator API provides early warning of WAN degradation across non-Cisco SD-WAN estates.

useCases.title: Aruba EdgeConnect SD-WAN Tunnel and Application Performance
useCases.value: HPE Aruba EdgeConnect (formerly Silver Peak) provides SD-WAN with WAN optimization. Monitoring tunnel health, boost metrics, and application path steering ensures WAN fabric reliability for organizations running Aruba SD-WAN alongside or instead of Cisco.

useCases.title: Versa Networks SD-WAN Path Quality and Routing Decisions
useCases.value: Versa Networks provides integrated SD-WAN, security, and routing. Monitoring path quality scores, SLA violations, and routing decisions across Versa FlexVNF devices enables proactive WAN management for Versa deployments.

useCases.title: Fortinet SD-WAN Health-Check and SLA Compliance
useCases.value: Fortinet SD-WAN is embedded in FortiGate appliances and is one of the most widely deployed SD-WAN solutions. Monitoring SD-WAN health-check probe results and SLA rule violations across FortiGate devices ensures WAN path reliability and application performance.

useCases.title: Cato Networks SASE Event Monitoring
useCases.value: Cato Networks provides a cloud-native SASE platform combining SD-WAN with network security. Monitoring socket (edge device) health, PoP connectivity, and security events from Cato provides unified visibility for organizations using SASE as their primary WAN architecture.

useCases.title: DNS Query Volume Trending
useCases.value: DNS query volume trending supports capacity planning and reveals traffic pattern changes.

useCases.title: NXDOMAIN Spike Detection
useCases.value: NXDOMAIN spikes indicate DGA malware (generating random domain lookups), misconfiguration, or DNS infrastructure issues.

useCases.title: SERVFAIL Rate Monitoring
useCases.value: SERVFAIL increases indicate upstream DNS failures, DNSSEC validation issues, or resolver problems.

useCases.title: DNS Tunneling Detection
useCases.value: DNS tunneling uses DNS queries to exfiltrate data or establish C2 channels, bypassing traditional security controls.

useCases.title: DHCP Scope Exhaustion
useCases.value: Empty DHCP scopes prevent new devices from getting network access.

useCases.title: DHCP Rogue Server Detection
useCases.value: Rogue DHCP servers assign wrong IPs/gateways, causing network disruption and potential MitM attacks.

useCases.title: DNS Record Change Audit
useCases.value: Unauthorized DNS changes can redirect traffic to attacker infrastructure (DNS hijacking).

useCases.title: DNS Latency Monitoring
useCases.value: DNS latency directly adds to every network connection. Slow DNS = slow everything.

useCases.title: DNS Cache Hit Ratio
useCases.value: Low cache hit ratios indicate either a surge of new queries, cache poisoning attempts, or misconfigured TTLs — all increasing latency and upstream load.

useCases.title: DNSSEC Validation Failures
useCases.value: DNSSEC failures can indicate DNS spoofing attempts or misconfigured zones. Monitoring prevents users from being directed to malicious sites.

useCases.title: DHCP Lease Duration Analysis
useCases.value: Short lease durations increase DHCP traffic and scope churn. Long leases waste addresses. Optimizing lease times improves IP management.

useCases.title: DNS Query Type Distribution
useCases.value: Unusual query type distribution (spikes in TXT, MX, or ANY) can indicate DNS tunneling, reconnaissance, or abuse.

useCases.title: Failed DHCP Assignments and IP Pool Exhaustion (Meraki)
useCases.value: Detects DHCP server failures and IP pool exhaustion that prevent new clients from obtaining addresses.

useCases.title: DNS Resolution Performance and Failures (Meraki)
useCases.value: Monitors DNS query resolution times and failures to identify misconfiguration or server issues affecting user experience.

useCases.title: DHCP Pool Exhaustion and Address Allocation Issues (Meraki)
useCases.value: Alerts when DHCP pools approach depletion to prevent clients from obtaining IP addresses.

useCases.title: DHCP Lease Exhaustion and Scope Utilization
useCases.value: Exhausted DHCP scopes prevent new devices from joining the network. Monitoring utilization and lease count supports proactive scope expansion or cleanup.

useCases.title: DNS Query Latency and Resolution Failure by Resolver
useCases.value: Slow or failing DNS resolution impacts all applications. Tracking latency and NXDOMAIN/timeout rates per resolver supports capacity and upstream provider decisions.

useCases.title: BlueCat DNS Edge Query Analytics
useCases.value: BlueCat DNS Edge provides DNS resolution at the edge with centralized policy management. Monitoring query volume, NXDOMAIN rates, and policy-blocked queries from BlueCat complements or replaces bind/Infoblox DNS monitoring for organizations using BlueCat as their DDI platform.

useCases.title: BlueCat DHCP Lease Utilization and Scope Health
useCases.value: BlueCat DHCP servers manage IP address allocation for enterprise networks. Monitoring scope utilization, lease churn, and assignment failures from BlueCat prevents address exhaustion and enables proactive capacity planning for organizations using BlueCat DDI.

useCases.title: Top Talkers Analysis
useCases.value: Identifies top bandwidth consumers. Essential for troubleshooting congestion and capacity planning.

useCases.title: Anomalous Traffic Patterns
useCases.value: Unusual flows (new protocols, unexpected destinations) indicate compromise, misconfiguration, or shadow IT.

useCases.title: Bandwidth by Application
useCases.value: Application-level bandwidth breakdown helps prioritize QoS policies and justify network upgrades.

useCases.title: East-West Traffic Monitoring
useCases.value: Lateral traffic between internal segments reveals application dependencies and detects lateral movement.

useCases.title: Data Exfiltration Detection
useCases.value: Unusually large outbound transfers to uncommon destinations may be data theft.

useCases.title: Port Scan Detection
useCases.value: Hosts scanning many ports on targets indicate reconnaissance, worm propagation, or vulnerability scanning.

useCases.title: Protocol Distribution Analysis
useCases.value: Understanding protocol mix helps validate network policies and detect unauthorized protocols (e.g., unexpected SSH, RDP, or P2P traffic).

useCases.title: Multicast Traffic Monitoring
useCases.value: Uncontrolled multicast traffic floods switches and consumes bandwidth. Monitoring ensures multicast storms are detected before impacting unicast traffic.

useCases.title: Unauthorized VLAN Traffic Detection
useCases.value: Traffic originating from or destined to unauthorized VLANs indicates misconfigured switch ports, VLAN hopping attacks, or rogue devices.

useCases.title: Long-Duration Flow Detection
useCases.value: Extremely long-lived flows may indicate data exfiltration, persistent backdoors, or stuck sessions consuming resources.

useCases.title: Zeek (Bro) Connection Log Analysis
useCases.value: Zeek (formerly Bro) generates structured connection, DNS, HTTP, SSL, and file logs from network packet captures. Zeek conn.log provides rich metadata (duration, bytes, connection state) for threat hunting, anomaly detection, and network forensics beyond what NetFlow alone provides.

useCases.title: SPAN/TAP Port and Packet Broker Health
useCases.value: Network visibility infrastructure (SPAN sessions, TAP aggregators, packet brokers like Gigamon, Keysight, Ixia) silently fails when ports go down, filters misconfigure, or buffers overflow. Monitoring the health of the visibility layer ensures that downstream tools (Zeek, Suricata, DLP) receive complete traffic copies.

useCases.title: DNA Center Assurance Alerts (Cisco Catalyst Center)
useCases.value: DNA Center provides AI/ML-driven network issue detection. Centralizing in Splunk enables cross-domain correlation.

useCases.title: Meraki Organization Monitoring
useCases.value: Tracks Meraki device status across all networks and organizations from a single pane.

useCases.title: SNMP Trap Consolidation
useCases.value: Centralizing SNMP traps from all sources enables cross-tool correlation and reduces monitoring tool sprawl.

useCases.title: Network Device Inventory
useCases.value: Up-to-date inventory supports change management, vulnerability tracking, and compliance auditing.

useCases.title: Network Device Backup Compliance
useCases.value: Missing backups mean a failed device requires manual rebuilding. Tracking backup success ensures rapid disaster recovery.

useCases.title: Network Configuration Drift Detection
useCases.value: Configuration drift from golden standards introduces vulnerabilities and operational inconsistencies. Detecting drift maintains compliance.

useCases.title: SNMP Polling Gap Detection
useCases.value: Missing SNMP polls create gaps in monitoring data. Detecting polling failures ensures metrics dashboards remain accurate.

useCases.title: SSL/TLS Certificate Expiration Tracking (Meraki)
useCases.value: Monitors SSL certificate expiration dates on all network devices to prevent outages.

useCases.title: Firmware Update Compliance and Version Tracking (Meraki)
useCases.value: Ensures all network devices run supported firmware versions and patches.

useCases.title: API Call Rate Monitoring and Rate Limit Alerts (Meraki)
useCases.value: Monitors API usage to prevent rate limit hits and optimize automation efficiency.

useCases.title: License Expiration Tracking and Renewal Alerts (Meraki)
useCases.value: Ensures licenses don't expire unexpectedly and features remain available.

useCases.title: Network Device Inventory and Change Audit (Meraki)
useCases.value: Maintains accurate inventory of network devices and tracks hardware/software changes.

useCases.title: Admin Activity Logging and Access Control Audit (Meraki)
useCases.value: Tracks administrator actions and logins for compliance and security auditing.

useCases.title: Admin Privilege Changes and Permission Escalation (Meraki)
useCases.value: Detects unauthorized privilege changes and permission escalation attempts.

useCases.title: Alert Volume Trending and Alert Fatigue Analysis (Meraki)
useCases.value: Analyzes alert volume trends to optimize alerting rules and reduce false positives.

useCases.title: Network Health Score Aggregation and Executive Reporting (Meraki)
useCases.value: Provides high-level network health metric for executive dashboards and trend reporting.

useCases.title: Device Online/Offline Status Monitoring (Meraki)
useCases.value: Tracks device connectivity status to quickly identify and respond to device failures.

useCases.title: Multi-Organization Comparison and Benchmarking (Meraki)
useCases.value: Compares metrics across organizations to identify best practices and outliers.

useCases.title: Configuration Change Window Compliance (Meraki)
useCases.value: Ensures configuration changes only occur within approved maintenance windows.

useCases.title: Webhook Delivery Failure Tracking (Meraki)
useCases.value: Ensures webhook notifications reach integrations and alerts don't get lost.

useCases.title: API Error Rate and Endpoint Health (Meraki)
useCases.value: Monitors API endpoint health and error rates to ensure automation reliability.

useCases.title: Dashboard Configuration and Export Backup (Meraki)
useCases.value: Tracks dashboard configuration backups to enable disaster recovery and configuration review.

useCases.title: Network Device Configuration Backup and Drift
useCases.value: Missing or stale configuration backups complicate recovery after failure or bad change. Detecting backup failure or config drift supports change control and RTO.

useCases.title: SNMP Trap Storm Detection
useCases.value: Excessive SNMP traps from a device indicating failure cascade.

useCases.title: CDN Origin Hit Rate and Cache Efficiency (CloudFront / Akamai / Fastly)
useCases.value: CDN cache efficiency directly impacts origin server load and end-user latency. Monitoring cache hit ratio, origin pull rates, and edge error rates across CloudFront, Akamai, or Fastly identifies misconfigured cache policies, cache-busting clients, and origin capacity risks before they affect user experience.

useCases.title: CDN Edge Error Rate and 5xx Response Monitoring
useCases.value: Elevated 5xx error rates at the CDN edge indicate origin failures, capacity issues, or CDN configuration problems. Monitoring edge-delivered error rates across CDN providers ensures rapid detection of service degradation visible to end users.

useCases.title: Network Latency Monitoring (Agent-to-Server)
useCases.value: Tracks round-trip latency from ThousandEyes agents to target servers, revealing network path degradation before users report slowness.

useCases.title: Network Packet Loss Monitoring
useCases.value: Packet loss directly degrades application performance, voice quality, and video conferencing. Even 1% loss can cause noticeable user impact.

useCases.title: Network Jitter Monitoring
useCases.value: Jitter (variation in packet delay) directly affects real-time applications like VoIP and video. High jitter degrades voice quality even when latency is acceptable.

useCases.title: Agent-to-Agent Latency and Throughput
useCases.value: Measures bidirectional network performance between two ThousandEyes agents, useful for assessing site-to-site WAN link quality and SD-WAN overlay performance.

useCases.title: Path Hop Count Analysis
useCases.value: Sudden changes in the number of hops to a target can indicate routing changes, path instability, or sub-optimal traffic engineering. The Splunk App provides min-hop drilldowns on the Network dashboard.

useCases.title: Network Path Change Detection
useCases.value: Detects when the network path between an agent and a target changes, which can indicate routing instability, ISP re-routing, or failover events. Correlating path changes with latency spikes helps isolate root cause.

useCases.title: WAN Link Quality Scoring
useCases.value: Composite quality score derived from latency, loss, and jitter provides a single metric for WAN link health, simplifying executive reporting and SLA tracking.

useCases.title: BGP Reachability Monitoring
useCases.value: Monitors whether BGP-advertised prefixes are reachable from global vantage points. Loss of reachability means users in affected regions cannot reach your services.

useCases.title: BGP Path Change Trending
useCases.value: BGP path changes indicate routing instability. Frequent path changes can cause traffic to take sub-optimal routes, increasing latency or traversing unexpected transit providers.

useCases.title: BGP Update Volume Tracking
useCases.value: High BGP update volumes can indicate route flapping, peer instability, or DDoS-related route manipulation. Trending helps establish baselines and detect anomalies.

useCases.title: BGP AS Path Monitoring
useCases.value: Tracking AS path changes reveals when traffic is routed through unexpected autonomous systems, which can indicate route leaks, hijacks, or ISP peering changes.

useCases.title: Prefix Reachability by Region
useCases.value: Comparing BGP prefix reachability across geographic regions identifies regional outages or ISP-specific routing issues that affect only certain user populations.

useCases.title: DNS Availability Monitoring
useCases.value: DNS failures cascade into application outages — if users cannot resolve names, nothing works. ThousandEyes DNS tests monitor availability from multiple global vantage points.

useCases.title: DNS Resolution Time Trending
useCases.value: Slow DNS resolution adds latency to every connection. Trending resolution time helps identify degrading DNS infrastructure or inefficient recursive resolution chains.

useCases.title: DNSSEC Validity Monitoring
useCases.value: DNSSEC validation failures cause hard resolution failures for DNSSEC-enforcing resolvers. Monitoring validity ensures the DNSSEC chain of trust remains intact.

useCases.title: DNS Provider Comparison
useCases.value: Comparing resolution times across DNS providers (internal recursive resolvers, external providers like Cloudflare, Google, ISP resolvers) helps optimize DNS configuration for lowest latency.

useCases.title: DNS Trace Delegation Chain Monitoring
useCases.value: DNS Trace tests follow the full delegation chain from root to authoritative server. Monitoring availability and duration across the chain identifies issues at specific levels of the DNS hierarchy.

useCases.title: Network Outage Event Detection
useCases.value: ThousandEyes Internet Insights uses collective intelligence from billions of daily measurements to automatically detect network outages affecting your services, including outages in ISP and cloud provider networks you do not own.

useCases.title: ISP Performance Degradation Alerts
useCases.value: ThousandEyes alerts notify when ISP-level degradation is detected. Ingesting these alerts into Splunk provides a centralized view alongside other infrastructure alerts and enables correlation with internal incidents.

useCases.title: DNS Issue Event Tracking
useCases.value: ThousandEyes Internet Insights automatically detects DNS infrastructure issues that deviate from established baselines, surfacing problems in third-party DNS services before they cause widespread outages.

useCases.title: Proxy Issue Detection
useCases.value: Detects when proxy infrastructure (forward proxies, web gateways, SASE secure edges) becomes the root cause of connectivity issues, helping teams quickly identify whether the problem is in the proxy layer or the destination.

useCases.title: Local Agent Issue Monitoring
useCases.value: Detects when the source of a test failure is the agent itself (local network, DNS, or connectivity issue at the agent location), preventing false attribution of problems to the destination service.

useCases.title: Internet Outage Correlation with Internal Alerts
useCases.value: Correlating ThousandEyes outage events with internal monitoring alerts enables rapid determination of whether an issue is caused by an external internet problem or an internal infrastructure failure, significantly reducing MTTR.

useCases.title: Endpoint Experience Score Monitoring
useCases.value: ThousandEyes Endpoint Agents provide a composite experience score aggregating CPU, memory, and network performance from the end-user device perspective, enabling proactive digital experience management for hybrid workforces.

useCases.title: Remote Worker Connectivity Health
useCases.value: Endpoint agents break connectivity into segments (gateway, VPN, proxy, DNS) with per-segment latency, loss, and score, enabling targeted troubleshooting of remote worker network issues without requiring on-site visits.

useCases.title: VPN Path Performance
useCases.value: Measures latency, loss, and quality through VPN tunnels from endpoint agents, identifying whether the VPN concentrator or provider is the bottleneck for remote workers.

useCases.title: Endpoint Connection Type and Network Score
useCases.value: Comparing network scores across connection types (Wireless, Ethernet, Modem) identifies whether WiFi or wired connectivity is a systemic issue for the workforce, informing infrastructure investment decisions.

useCases.title: Geographic Workforce Performance Comparison
useCases.value: Comparing digital experience metrics across office locations and regions identifies sites with persistent network quality issues, enabling targeted infrastructure improvements.

useCases.title: SD-WAN Overlay vs Underlay Performance
useCases.value: Compares performance metrics across SD-WAN overlay tunnels and their underlay transport paths, revealing when SD-WAN policy routing decisions are sub-optimal or when underlay degradation affects the overlay.

useCases.title: SASE Secure Edge Performance
useCases.value: SASE architectures route traffic through cloud-based security edges (Zscaler, Cisco Umbrella, etc.). Monitoring latency and loss through these edges ensures the security layer does not unacceptably degrade user experience.

useCases.title: Multi-Cloud Network Performance
useCases.value: Measures network path performance to workloads hosted across AWS, Azure, GCP, and other cloud providers, identifying which provider or region delivers the best connectivity from each user location.

useCases.title: CDN Edge Network Performance
useCases.value: Measures latency, loss, and path characteristics to CDN edge locations, revealing when CDN performance varies by region or when edge servers are not serving content as expected.

useCases.title: Cloud Provider Path Visualization
useCases.value: Hop-by-hop path visualization through cloud provider backbones reveals routing decisions, peering points, and potential bottlenecks within AWS, Azure, or GCP networks that are otherwise invisible.

useCases.title: HTTP Server Availability Monitoring (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Monitors web server availability from multiple global vantage points using ThousandEyes Cloud and Enterprise Agents. Detects regional outages that internal monitoring misses because the problem is between the user and the server.

useCases.title: HTTP Server Response Time Tracking (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Tracks Time to First Byte (TTFB) from ThousandEyes agents to web servers. Rising response times indicate backend degradation, infrastructure bottlenecks, or increased load — often visible from external vantage points before internal monitoring catches it.

useCases.title: HTTP Server Throughput Analysis (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Measures download throughput from ThousandEyes agents to web servers, revealing bandwidth constraints or content delivery issues from the user perspective.

useCases.title: Page Load Completion Rate (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Measures whether web pages fully load from the user's perspective. Incomplete page loads indicate broken resources, blocked CDN content, or JavaScript errors that prevent users from completing tasks.

useCases.title: Page Load Duration Trending (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Tracks total page load time including all resources (HTML, CSS, JS, images). Trending reveals gradual degradation from growing page weight, slow third-party resources, or backend issues.

useCases.title: API Endpoint Completion Rate (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Monitors multi-step API test completion, ensuring that entire API workflows (authentication, data retrieval, processing) succeed end-to-end from external vantage points.

useCases.title: API Response Time Monitoring (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Tracks total API test execution duration including all steps, revealing when API performance degrades from the consumer's perspective.

useCases.title: Transaction Test Completion Rate (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Transaction tests execute scripted multi-step user workflows (login, navigate, submit form, verify result). Completion rate below 100% means users cannot complete critical business processes.

useCases.title: Transaction Duration Analysis (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Measures end-to-end time for complex user workflows. Slow transactions directly impact user productivity and satisfaction. Trending reveals gradual degradation across the multi-step flow.

useCases.title: SaaS Application Response Time Comparison (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Compares availability and response time across business-critical SaaS applications (Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) from multiple office locations, enabling data-driven SaaS vendor performance management.

useCases.title: Multi-Region SaaS Availability (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Monitors SaaS application reachability from multiple geographic regions using ThousandEyes Cloud Agents, identifying regional availability issues that affect specific user populations.

useCases.title: FTP Server Availability and Throughput (ThousandEyes)
useCases.value: Monitors FTP/SFTP server availability and file transfer throughput from ThousandEyes agents, ensuring file transfer services are accessible and performing adequately for automated data exchange workflows.

useCases.title: ThousandEyes Alert Severity Distribution
useCases.value: Provides a centralized view of all ThousandEyes alerts in Splunk by severity, enabling SOC and NOC teams to prioritize response across network, application, and voice test alerts alongside other infrastructure alerts.

useCases.title: ThousandEyes Alert Timeline Trending
useCases.value: Trending alert volume over time reveals patterns — recurring issues at specific times, increasing alert frequency indicating degradation, or correlation with change windows. Helps teams move from reactive to proactive operations.

useCases.title: ThousandEyes Activity Log Audit Trail
useCases.value: Ingests ThousandEyes platform activity logs into Splunk for audit, compliance, and change tracking. Tracks who created, modified, or deleted tests, users, and alert rules — essential for troubleshooting test behavior changes and meeting compliance requirements.

useCases.title: ThousandEyes Data Collection Health Monitoring
useCases.value: Monitors the health of the ThousandEyes-to-Splunk data pipeline itself. Detects gaps in data collection, API errors, or HEC delivery failures that would cause blind spots in network and application monitoring.

app: ITSI Content Pack for Cisco ThousandEyes
useCases.title: ThousandEyes ITSI Service Health (Content Pack)
useCases.value: The ITSI Content Pack for Cisco ThousandEyes provides pre-built service templates, KPI base searches, entity types, and Glass Tables for service-centric monitoring. It maps ThousandEyes test results to ITSI services for unified health scoring across all monitoring domains.

app: ThousandEyes webhook integration with Splunk On-Call
useCases.title: Splunk On-Call Incident Routing from ThousandEyes
useCases.value: Routes ThousandEyes alerts directly to Splunk On-Call (formerly VictorOps) for incident management, on-call paging, and war room coordination. Ensures network and application issues detected by ThousandEyes reach the right team within seconds.

useCases.title: ThousandEyes Trace Span Analysis and Drill-Down
useCases.value: ThousandEyes Transaction tests can emit OpenTelemetry traces with span-level timing for each step of the scripted workflow. Ingesting these traces into Splunk enables correlation with application traces from Splunk APM for end-to-end distributed tracing.

useCases.title: Cross-Platform Correlation (ThousandEyes Network + Splunk APM)
useCases.value: Correlates ThousandEyes network path quality data with Splunk APM application traces to determine whether performance issues are caused by the network or the application. This is the core value proposition of the Splunk + ThousandEyes integration — unified observability across network and application layers.

useCases.title: MTTR Reduction via Network vs Application Isolation
useCases.value: Quantifies the business value of ThousandEyes + Splunk integration by measuring how quickly teams can isolate whether a performance issue is network-caused or application-caused. Tracks Mean Time to Resolution and Mean Time to Isolate metrics for incidents where ThousandEyes data was available.

useCases.title: Diameter Signaling Health Monitoring
useCases.value: Tracks the success and failure rates of Diameter signaling messages (authentication, authorization, accounting) in the mobile core, essential for maintaining service availability and subscriber experience.

useCases.title: Diameter Subscriber Data Accounting
useCases.value: Aggregates Diameter accounting records to track data usage per subscriber and session, enabling detection of high-usage anomalies, billing reconciliation, and capacity planning.

useCases.title: Mobile Subscriber RADIUS Session Tracking
useCases.value: Tracks active mobile subscriber sessions via RADIUS accounting, providing visibility into session duration, data volume, and SGSN/MCC-MNC distribution — critical for mobile core capacity planning and roaming analytics.

useCases.title: Carrier SIP Trunk Failure Analysis
useCases.value: Monitors SIP response codes on carrier trunks to detect call routing failures, trunk congestion, and destination unreachable conditions — directly impacting voice service availability and revenue.

useCases.title: SIP Registration Storm Detection
useCases.value: Detects sudden spikes in SIP REGISTER messages that can overwhelm IMS/SBC infrastructure — caused by mass device reboots, network flaps, or DDoS attacks. Early detection prevents cascading core failures.

useCases.title: SIP Post-Dial Delay Monitoring
useCases.value: Measures the time between a SIP INVITE and the first ringing or answer response, directly reflecting the user experience of waiting after dialing. High post-dial delay indicates trunk congestion, routing loops, or downstream SBC issues.

useCases.title: Interface Utilization via gNMI Streaming Counters
useCases.value: SNMP polls interface counters every 5 minutes at best — microbursts and sub-minute congestion are invisible. gNMI SAMPLE subscriptions stream `/interfaces/interface/state/counters` at 10-30 second intervals, giving you near-real-time ingress/egress byte and packet rates. This catches congestion events that SNMP misses and enables capacity planning based on true peak utilization rather than averaged-out polling data.

useCases.title: Interface Error and Discard Streaming
useCases.value: CRC errors, input errors, and output discards often precede link failure or indicate a bad transceiver, duplex mismatch, or MTU issue. Streaming these counters at 30-second intervals via gNMI catches error bursts that 5-minute SNMP polls average away. A sudden spike in `in_fcs_errors` on a 100G spine link demands immediate investigation — it could be a failing optic about to take down a leaf.

useCases.title: BGP Peer State Change Detection via ON_CHANGE
useCases.value: Syslog-based BGP monitoring depends on log forwarding latency and parsing reliability. gNMI ON_CHANGE subscriptions to BGP neighbor state deliver sub-second notification when a peer leaves Established — faster than syslog and with structured data. For VXLAN EVPN fabrics where BGP is both underlay and overlay, a single peer drop can black-hole tenant traffic within seconds.

useCases.title: System CPU and Memory Utilization Streaming
useCases.value: Network device control planes running hot indicate routing churn, excessive logging, or a control-plane DoS. gNMI streaming at 30-second intervals catches transient CPU spikes that 5-minute SNMP polls miss entirely. A Nexus spine hitting 90% CPU during a BGP convergence event could start dropping BFD keepalives, cascading into a fabric-wide outage.

useCases.title: Optical Transceiver Health Monitoring
useCases.value: Optical transceivers fail gradually — Tx power drops, Rx power drifts, temperature climbs. By the time an interface goes down, the damage (packet loss, CRC errors, application impact) is already done. gNMI streaming of `/components/component` optic data at 60-second intervals enables predictive failure alerting: catch a dimming laser or overheating module hours before it causes an outage.

useCases.title: QoS Queue Depth and Drop Streaming
useCases.value: SNMP-polled QoS counters miss microbursts entirely — a 100ms queue overflow causes packet loss that a 5-minute poll never sees. gNMI SAMPLE subscriptions to `/qos/interfaces/interface/output/queues/queue/state` at 10-second intervals capture queue depth and transmit/drop counters at a granularity that reveals microburst patterns, misclassified traffic, and under-provisioned queues.

useCases.title: LLDP Topology Change Detection
useCases.value: In a properly cabled data center, the LLDP neighbor table should not change unless someone moves a cable, adds a device, or swaps a switch. gNMI ON_CHANGE subscriptions to `/lldp/interfaces/interface/neighbors` provide instant notification of topology drift — a new neighbor appearing on a spine port, a missing neighbor on a leaf uplink, or an unauthorized device connected to a reserved port.

useCases.title: BGP Prefix Count and Route Churn Monitoring
useCases.value: A sudden jump in received BGP prefixes could indicate a route leak, hijack, or misconfigured peer advertising a full table into a leaf switch. Conversely, a prefix count drop means routes are being withdrawn — potentially black-holing traffic. Streaming prefix counts via gNMI at 30-second intervals detects these events far faster than waiting for syslog or SNMP traps.

useCases.title: Hardware Component Health (Fan, PSU, Temperature)
useCases.value: Environmental monitoring via SNMP Entity-MIB polling is slow and often unreliable. gNMI streaming of `/components/component/state` provides real-time temperature, fan speed, and power supply status. A failing fan in a top-of-rack switch triggers thermal throttling within minutes — early detection prevents performance degradation and emergency hardware swaps during business hours.

useCases.title: Telegraf gNMI Collector Pipeline Health
useCases.value: If your Telegraf collector goes down or loses connectivity to a target device, all gNMI telemetry for that device stops silently — dashboards freeze at last-known-good values and alerts never fire. Monitoring the Telegraf pipeline itself (gather time, buffer usage, write failures, active connections) is essential to trust the data flowing through it.

useCases.title: ACL Hit Counter Analysis via Streaming Telemetry
useCases.value: ACL rules that never match traffic are dead weight that slows TCAM lookups and obscures security intent. Conversely, deny rules with climbing hit counts reveal active attack patterns. Streaming ACL counters via gNMI at 30-second intervals provides the data needed for security policy effectiveness analysis and ACL cleanup — tasks that are nearly impossible with periodic SNMP polling.

useCases.title: CDR Call Failure Statistics
useCases.value: Aggregates release causes, SIP response codes, and ISUP cause values from CDRs to spot trunk, routing, or peer outages early.

useCases.title: Call Volume Trending by Destination
useCases.value: Traffic engineering for trunk groups and geographic hot spots — detects flash crowds or fraud-driven spikes to premium destinations.

useCases.title: Call Duration Distribution Analysis
useCases.value: Shifts toward very short or very long holds may indicate robocall, modem, or toll fraud vs. normal conversational distribution.

useCases.title: SIP Trunk Utilization
useCases.value: Concurrent session counts or peg counts vs. licensed trunk capacity — prevents preemptive blocking at peak.

useCases.title: VoIP MOS Score Monitoring
useCases.value: Mean Opinion Score (or derived R-factor) from RTCP XR or vendor QoE reports — user-perceived VoLTE/VoIP quality.

useCases.title: Signaling Storm Detection
useCases.value: Bursts of SIP OPTIONS, REGISTER, or diameter requests can indicate reflection DDoS or misconfigured endpoints — complements UC-5.10.5 with cross-layer view.

useCases.title: IMS Registration Failure Rate
useCases.value: HSS/UDM or P-CSCF failures show up as elevated 401/403/timeout on REGISTER — impacts VoLTE attach and VoWiFi.

useCases.title: Number Portability Request Tracking
useCases.value: LNP order status, NPAC responses, and port-out churn — operations and regulatory reporting for porting SLAs.

useCases.title: Roaming Usage Anomaly
useCases.value: Sudden data/voice roaming volume from HLR/VLR or TAP records may indicate SIM box, cloned IMSI, or billing leakage.

useCases.title: Toll Fraud Detection
useCases.value: Premium-rate, international, or short-duration high-cost patterns from compromised PBX or SIP credentials — classic CDR analytics use case.

useCases.title: Volume Capacity Trending
useCases.value: Prevents application outages caused by full volumes. Enables proactive capacity planning and procurement.

useCases.title: Storage Latency Monitoring
useCases.value: High storage latency directly impacts application performance. Early detection prevents SLA breaches and user experience degradation.

useCases.title: IOPS Trending per Volume
useCases.value: Identifies workload hotspots and enables data placement optimization. Supports capacity planning for storage refreshes.

useCases.title: Disk Failure Alerts
useCases.value: Immediate awareness of disk failures allows replacement before RAID degradation leads to data loss.

useCases.title: Replication Lag Monitoring
useCases.value: Replication lag directly impacts RPO. Monitoring ensures DR readiness and compliance with data protection SLAs.

useCases.title: Controller Failover Events
useCases.value: Controller failovers indicate hardware problems and may cause transient performance impact. Quick detection ensures rapid root cause analysis.

useCases.title: Thin Provisioning Overcommit
useCases.value: Over-committed thin-provisioned storage can cause sudden outages when physical capacity is exhausted. Monitoring prevents surprise failures.

useCases.title: Snapshot Space Consumption
useCases.value: Runaway snapshot growth can consume all available space, causing volume and application outages.

useCases.title: Fibre Channel Port Errors
useCases.value: FC port errors cause storage performance degradation and potential path failovers. Early detection prevents cascading failures.

useCases.title: Storage Array Firmware Compliance
useCases.value: Outdated firmware exposes arrays to known bugs and security vulnerabilities. Compliance tracking supports patching cadence.

app: Splunk Add-on for Dell EMC Isilon (if available)
or REST/API polling of OneFS platform API
useCases.title: Isilon Cluster and Node Health
useCases.value: Dell EMC Isilon (OneFS) is a scale-out NAS platform. Monitoring node and cluster health ensures availability and early detection of hardware or software issues before data access is impacted.

app: OneFS API or vendor add-on for Isilon metrics
useCases.title: Isilon Capacity and Performance Trending
useCases.value: Tracks Isilon cluster capacity and throughput (e.g. ops/sec, throughput MB/s) for capacity planning and performance troubleshooting. Matches IT Essentials Learn procedures for Isilon storage.

useCases.title: TrueNAS / FreeNAS Pool Health
useCases.value: ZFS pool degradation, scrub results, and resilver progress directly impact data integrity. Early detection of unhealthy pools prevents data loss and enables timely intervention during rebuilds.

useCases.title: Ceph Cluster Health and OSD Status
useCases.value: Ceph health warnings, OSD down/out events, and placement group (PG) state issues can lead to data unavailability or loss. Monitoring ensures rapid response to cluster degradation.

useCases.title: NFS Export Availability
useCases.value: NFS mount point reachability and latency directly affect application availability. Monitoring from client perspective ensures end-to-end access validation.

useCases.title: SMB / CIFS Share Availability
useCases.value: Windows/SMB share reachability is critical for file-serving workloads. Monitoring ensures shares are accessible before users report issues.

useCases.title: RAID Rebuild Progress and Estimated Completion
useCases.value: During array rebuilds, progress percentage and ETA help plan maintenance and detect stalled rebuilds. Stalled rebuilds increase risk of data loss if another disk fails.

useCases.title: NetApp ONTAP Performance Counters
useCases.value: Counter-based throughput, latency, and queue depth from ONTAP complement volume-level views. Trending counters catches node or aggregate saturation before user-visible latency spikes.

useCases.title: Pure Storage Array Health
useCases.value: Pure FA/FB controller, component, and capacity health events indicate hardware or software risk. Unified visibility supports proactive replacement and support cases.

useCases.title: iSCSI Session Monitoring
useCases.value: Dropped or flapping iSCSI sessions cause path loss and I/O errors. Session count and login state trending validates host-to-array connectivity after network or firmware changes.

useCases.title: Multipath Failover Events
useCases.value: Path failovers indicate cable, SFP, HBA, or array port issues. Rapid detection limits prolonged single-path exposure and data loss risk.

useCases.title: Fibre Channel Port Error Rate (Array)
useCases.value: Array-side FC port CRCs, signal loss, and link failures differ from switch-only views. Port error rate trending isolates HBA/cable issues at the storage attachment point.

useCases.title: LUN Latency Trending
useCases.value: Per-LUN latency separates noisy neighbors and misaligned workloads from array-wide issues. Supports QoS and datastore placement decisions.

useCases.title: Aggregate Space Forecasting
useCases.value: Forecasting aggregate free space prevents sudden write failures on thin-provisioned pools. Supports procurement and volume migration planning.

useCases.title: Snapshot Schedule Compliance
useCases.value: Missed snapshot schedules break backup and rollback expectations. Verifying snapshot recency per policy supports operational and audit requirements.

useCases.title: Deduplication Savings Ratio
useCases.value: Deduplication ratio trending validates efficiency features and detects anomalies (sudden ratio drop may indicate new data types or misconfiguration).

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: MDS Inter-Switch Link (ISL) Utilization
useCases.value: ISLs carry all inter-switch SAN traffic. Saturated ISLs cause frame queuing, slow drain propagation, and storage latency spikes. Proactive monitoring prevents cascading congestion before hosts see I/O timeouts.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: MDS Slow Drain Detection
useCases.value: Slow drain occurs when a target device (storage or host) cannot accept frames fast enough, exhausting buffer-to-buffer credits and stalling the entire FC path. A single slow-drain device can impact hundreds of hosts sharing the same ISL. Early detection via TxWait and B2B credit metrics is essential.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: MDS Zone Configuration Compliance
useCases.value: Zoning controls which initiators can communicate with which targets. Misconfigured zones create security risks (unauthorized access) and operational risks (accidental data access). Tracking zone changes and validating against a known-good baseline prevents drift.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: MDS FLOGI Database Monitoring
useCases.value: The FLOGI (Fabric Login) database records every device that has logged into the SAN fabric. Monitoring FLOGI events detects rogue devices, unexpected host logins, and fabric login storms that indicate HBA or driver issues.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: MDS VSAN Health and Isolation Events
useCases.value: VSANs provide logical SAN segmentation. VSAN isolation events (caused by ISL failures, misconfigured trunking, or merge failures) split the fabric and break host-to-storage paths. Detecting isolation within seconds is essential for maintaining storage availability.

useCases.title: MDS SAN Fabric Oversubscription Ratio
useCases.value: The ratio of total edge port bandwidth to ISL bandwidth determines oversubscription. High oversubscription ratios (>7:1 for production, >20:1 for backup) increase the risk of congestion. Tracking this metric supports capacity planning and fabric expansion decisions.

useCases.title: Bucket Capacity Trending
useCases.value: Tracks storage growth for cost forecasting and lifecycle policy effectiveness. Prevents unexpected cloud bills.

useCases.title: Access Pattern Anomalies
useCases.value: Unusual access patterns may indicate data breaches, compromised credentials, or misconfigured applications.

useCases.title: Public Bucket Detection
useCases.value: Public buckets are a top cloud security risk, leading to data breaches. Immediate detection is essential for compliance.

useCases.title: Lifecycle Policy Compliance
useCases.value: Ensures storage cost optimization policies are working. Objects not transitioning per policy waste money.

useCases.title: Cross-Region Replication Lag
useCases.value: Replication lag affects DR readiness. Monitoring ensures geo-redundant data meets RPO requirements.

useCases.title: S3 and Azure Blob Lifecycle Policy Compliance
useCases.value: Confirms lifecycle rules exist per bucket/container and that transitions match tagging/age rules. Reduces cost leakage from objects stuck in hot tiers.

useCases.title: Cross-Region Replication Lag (SLA)
useCases.value: Tracks replication backlog and oldest replicated object age for S3 CRR and Azure geo-replication. Complements byte-level lag with time-based SLA views.

useCases.title: Bucket Policy Change Audit
useCases.value: Unexpected bucket policy or IAM policy changes can expose data. Audit trail supports SOC2/PCI evidence and fast rollback.

useCases.title: Pre-Signed URL Abuse Detection
useCases.value: Unusual volume of pre-signed GET/PUT or access from unexpected IPs may indicate credential theft or insider abuse.

useCases.title: Storage Class Transition Tracking
useCases.value: Validates that objects move to IA/Glacier/Archive per policy. Stalled transitions indicate rule gaps or unsupported objects.

useCases.title: Object Versioning Compliance
useCases.value: Buckets without versioning risk unrecoverable overwrites. Monitoring ensures critical buckets remain versioned per data policy.

useCases.title: Object Lock Integrity
useCases.value: WORM/immutability protects against ransomware and deletion. Verifies Object Lock retention mode and legal hold on regulated buckets.

useCases.title: Backup Job Success Rate
useCases.value: Failed backups leave systems unprotected. Tracking success rate ensures recoverability and compliance with data protection policies.

useCases.title: Backup Job Duration Trending
useCases.value: Increasing backup durations signal data growth, network congestion, or storage performance issues. Prevents backup window overruns.

useCases.title: Missed Backup Detection
useCases.value: A backup that doesn't run at all is worse than one that fails — it's invisible. Detection ensures no system is left unprotected.

useCases.title: Backup Storage Capacity
useCases.value: Running out of backup repository space causes all backup jobs to fail. Proactive monitoring prevents cascading failures.

useCases.title: Restore Test Tracking
useCases.value: Backups are worthless if restores fail. Tracking restore tests ensures confidence in recoverability and satisfies audit requirements.

useCases.title: Backup SLA Compliance
useCases.value: Consolidated view of backup coverage and RPO/RTO compliance. Essential for management reporting and audit evidence.

useCases.title: Backup Data Volume Trending
useCases.value: Tracks data growth rate for capacity planning of backup infrastructure. Identifies unexpected data surges early.

useCases.title: Tape Library Health
useCases.value: Tape media and drive failures can silently corrupt backups. Monitoring ensures long-term archival reliability.

useCases.title: Veeam Backup Job Monitoring
useCases.value: Job success/failure/warning status, duration, and data transferred are essential for backup reliability. Immediate visibility into job outcomes ensures data protection SLAs are met and enables rapid troubleshooting.

useCases.title: Backup Data Growth Rate
useCases.value: Backup repository consumption trending enables capacity planning and prevents surprise exhaustion. Proactive forecasting supports budget and procurement decisions.

useCases.title: Veeam Backup Job Status Summary
useCases.value: Roll-up of last job result per workload (Success/Warning/Failed/Running) for executive and NOC dashboards. Complements session-level detail with a single row per protected entity.

useCases.title: Commvault Job Completion
useCases.value: Failed or incomplete Commvault backup jobs leave subclients unprotected. Job-level success tracking is required for audit and restore confidence.

useCases.title: Backup RPO and RTO Compliance
useCases.value: Compares actual backup completion time and restore test duration against business RPO/RTO targets per application tier.

useCases.title: Tape Library Robotics and Drive Health
useCases.value: Mechanical faults, barcode read errors, and drive cleaning states cause failed backups before media errors. Dedicated robotics metrics reduce MTTR for tape operations.

useCases.title: DR Rehearsal Tracking
useCases.value: Tabletop and technical DR tests must occur on schedule. Tracking rehearsal outcomes and dates supports audit and readiness scoring.

useCases.title: Backup Window Utilization
useCases.value: Jobs that consume most of the backup window risk overlap with production or fail to finish. Utilization % guides schedule tuning and parallel job limits.

useCases.title: Incremental Backup Chain Integrity
useCases.value: Broken increment chains (missing full or corrupted metadata) make restores impossible. Vendor-specific checks detect chain gaps before a failure at restore time.

useCases.title: Backup Data Growth Trending by Workload
useCases.value: Per-workload front-end bytes backed up trend identifies data sprawl, VM growth, or unexpected database growth before repository exhaustion.

useCases.title: Windows Backup Job Monitoring
useCases.value: Windows Server Backup failures mean the server has no recovery point. Silent failures create a false sense of protection.

useCases.title: Backup Target Capacity and Growth Rate
useCases.value: Backup destination (disk, dedup appliance, object storage) that fills up causes backup failures and retention gaps. Tracking growth and remaining capacity prevents surprise outages.

useCases.title: Restore Job Success and Duration Trending
useCases.value: Restore failures or abnormally long restores indicate corrupt backups, network issues, or misconfiguration. Tracking ensures recovery procedures are validated and RTO is achievable.

useCases.title: Backup Job Overlap and Schedule Conflict Detection
useCases.value: Overlapping full backups or too many concurrent jobs overload the backup infrastructure and extend backup windows. Detecting overlap supports schedule tuning and resource sizing.

useCases.title: Immutable Backup and Ransomware Recovery Readiness
useCases.value: Immutable or air-gapped copies are the last line of defense against ransomware. Verifying immutability and recovery procedure readiness ensures backups cannot be deleted or encrypted by an attacker.

useCases.title: Tape Library Slot Utilization
useCases.value: Tape library capacity and media expiration tracking prevent backup failures when slots are exhausted or tapes expire. Supports capacity planning and media lifecycle management.

useCases.title: File Access Audit
useCases.value: Provides full audit trail of file access for compliance (SOX, HIPAA, PCI-DSS). Enables investigation of data breaches and unauthorized access.

useCases.title: Ransomware Indicator Detection
useCases.value: Ransomware causes mass file encryption in minutes. Detecting the pattern early can limit damage by triggering automated isolation.

useCases.title: DFS Replication Health
useCases.value: DFS-R backlog and conflicts indicate replication failures that can lead to data inconsistency and user complaints.

useCases.title: Share Permission Changes
useCases.value: Unauthorized permission changes can expose sensitive data. Change detection supports compliance and security posture.

useCases.title: Large File Transfer Detection
useCases.value: Unusually large file copies may indicate data exfiltration. Detection supports data loss prevention and insider threat programs.

useCases.title: Backup Encryption and Key Access Audit
useCases.value: Backup encryption keys must be used only by authorized backup jobs. Unusual key access or decryption attempts may indicate theft or ransomware. Auditing supports compliance and incident response.

useCases.title: DFS Replication Backlog and Connectivity Health
useCases.value: Backlog size and partner connectivity state predict replication stalls before user-visible file divergence. Complements event-only monitoring with quantitative backlog trending.

useCases.title: NFS Export Capacity and Client Load
useCases.value: Export-level capacity and NFS operations/sec highlight hot exports and approaching full filesystems on NAS heads.

useCases.title: SMB Share Access Audit
useCases.value: Summarizes successful and denied access to sensitive shares for insider threat and access reviews. Extends object-level 4663 views with share-level rollups.

useCases.title: File Server Capacity Trending
useCases.value: Volume-level free space trending on Windows file servers prevents user and application outages from full disks.

useCases.title: Ransomware File Extension Detection
useCases.value: Detects mass renames or creates with known ransomware extensions (e.g., `.locked`, `.encrypted`) faster than generic mass-modify heuristics in some campaigns.

useCases.title: CIFS Connection Monitoring
useCases.value: Tracks concurrent SMB sessions and failed session setups per file server. Spikes may indicate brute force, misconfigured apps, or server resource limits.

useCases.title: File Deletion Volume Anomaly
useCases.value: Sudden spike in delete operations may indicate ransomware preparation, malicious insider, or script error. Complements mass-modify ransomware use cases.

useCases.title: Slow Query Detection
useCases.value: Slow queries at the P95/P99 level directly impact checkout, search, and reporting latency, hitting revenue and SLA commitments. They also hold locks and inflate CPU/IO, degrading performance for other tenants and queries. Prioritize fixes by business-critical endpoint and wait type, not just raw query duration.

useCases.title: Deadlock Monitoring
useCases.value: Deadlocks cause transaction failures and application errors. Rapid detection and root cause analysis minimizes impact.

useCases.title: Connection Pool Exhaustion
useCases.value: Exhausted connection pools cause application failures. Monitoring prevents outages and guides pool sizing decisions.

useCases.title: Replication Lag Monitoring
useCases.value: Replication lag affects data consistency and failover readiness. Monitoring ensures HA/DR objectives are met.

useCases.title: Tablespace / Data File Growth
useCases.value: Uncontrolled database growth leads to disk space exhaustion and outages. Trending enables proactive storage provisioning.

useCases.title: Backup Success Verification
useCases.value: Database backups are the last line of defense. Verifying success prevents discovering backup failures during a crisis.

useCases.title: Login Failure Monitoring
useCases.value: Repeated login failures may indicate brute-force attacks or misconfigured applications. Detection supports security posture.

useCases.title: Long-Running Transaction Detection
useCases.value: Long transactions hold locks, causing blocking chains that degrade application performance for many users.

useCases.title: Index Fragmentation
useCases.value: Highly fragmented indexes cause excessive I/O and slow query performance. Monitoring guides maintenance scheduling.

useCases.title: TempDB Contention (SQL Server)
useCases.value: TempDB contention is a common SQL Server bottleneck. Detection enables configuration tuning (multiple data files, trace flags).

useCases.title: Buffer Cache Hit Ratio
useCases.value: Low buffer cache hit ratio means excessive disk I/O. Monitoring guides memory allocation decisions.

useCases.title: Database Availability Group Health
useCases.value: AG/RAC cluster health is essential for HA. Detecting unhealthy replicas prevents unplanned failover failures.

useCases.title: Schema Change Detection
useCases.value: Unauthorized DDL changes to production databases can break applications. Detection ensures change control compliance.

useCases.title: Query Plan Regression
useCases.value: Query plan changes can cause sudden performance degradation. Detection enables rapid intervention (plan forcing, hint application).

useCases.title: Privilege Escalation Audit
useCases.value: Unauthorized privilege changes can enable data theft or sabotage. Audit trail is required for compliance.

useCases.title: Open Cursor Leak Detection
useCases.value: Open cursors that are never closed accumulate in the database session context and eventually exhaust the cursor limit (Oracle ORA-01000, SQL Server max open cursors), causing application errors and forcing emergency restarts. Nagios detects this via threshold checks on V$OPEN_CURSOR; Splunk enables trending, per-session attribution, and correlation with application deployments.

useCases.title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
useCases.value: When the application connection pool or database max_connections is exhausted, new requests fail with connection errors. Detecting high connection count and pool saturation prevents outages.

useCases.title: Long-Running Query and Blocking Session Detection
useCases.value: Queries that run for hours or sessions that block others cause timeouts and user impact. Identifying blocking chains and long-running queries supports tuning and kill decisions.

useCases.title: Table and Index Bloat and Maintenance Window
useCases.value: Table and index bloat (PostgreSQL) or fragmentation (SQL Server) degrades query performance and wastes space. Tracking bloat and last vacuum/rebuild supports maintenance scheduling.

useCases.title: Database Backup and Archive Log Retention Verification
useCases.value: Failed or missing backups and unarchived redo logs risk data loss and prevent point-in-time recovery. Verifying backup success and archive log retention ensures RPO is met.

useCases.title: Database User and Privilege Change Audit
useCases.value: New users, role grants, or privilege changes can indicate compromise or policy violation. Auditing supports compliance (SOX, PCI) and security investigations.

useCases.title: PostgreSQL WAL Growth
useCases.value: WAL accumulation indicating replication issues or archival failures. Uncontrolled WAL growth exhausts disk space and can halt the database.

useCases.title: PostgreSQL Vacuum Activity
useCases.value: Autovacuum running, dead tuples, and table bloat affect query performance. Monitoring ensures vacuum keeps pace with write workload and prevents bloat.

useCases.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Monitoring (PgBouncer)
useCases.value: Pool utilization and wait queue length indicate connection pressure. High utilization or growing wait queue causes application timeouts.

useCases.title: MySQL / MariaDB InnoDB Buffer Pool Hit Ratio
useCases.value: Buffer pool effectiveness; low hit ratio means excessive disk I/O and degraded query performance.

useCases.title: MySQL Binary Log Space Usage
useCases.value: Binlog accumulation on disk can exhaust disk space and impact replication. Monitoring enables proactive purging or archival.

useCases.title: Oracle Tablespace Utilization
useCases.value: Approaching max size per tablespace causes ORA-1653 (out of space) errors and application failures. Proactive monitoring prevents outages.

useCases.title: PostgreSQL Replication Lag (Streaming)
useCases.value: `pg_stat_replication` write/flush/replay lag bytes and seconds catch standby drift before read-your-writes violations. Complements generic replication UC with PostgreSQL-native metrics.

useCases.title: MySQL InnoDB Buffer Pool Hit Ratio Monitoring
useCases.value: Fleet-wide buffer pool hit ratio SLO for MySQL/MariaDB with per-instance drilldown. Aligns capacity reviews with read IO pressure.

useCases.title: Oracle Tablespace Growth Trending
useCases.value: Week-over-week growth rate per tablespace drives forecast and ASM/space procurement. Extends point-in-time utilization with trend.

useCases.title: SQL Server Always On AG Health and Replica Sync
useCases.value: Combined view of `synchronization_health`, redo queue, and log send queue sizes for AG replicas. Operationalizes UC-7.1.12 with queue depth.

useCases.title: Database Backup Chain Validation
useCases.value: Verifies full→diff→log chain continuity (SQL Server LSN chain, Oracle archivelog sequence) to detect missing backups before restore drills fail.

useCases.title: Long-Running Query Detection (Active Sessions)
useCases.value: Surfaces currently running queries exceeding elapsed threshold with SQL hash and wait type—faster triage than transaction-only UC-7.1.8.

useCases.title: Deadlock Frequency by Database
useCases.value: Counts deadlocks per hour/database to detect code regressions after releases. Complements UC-7.1.2 event search with KPIs.

useCases.title: Connection Pool Exhaustion (Application vs Database Limit)
useCases.value: Joins app pool `activeThreads`/`waiting` with DB `session_count` to distinguish app-side pool starvation from DB `max_connections` hits.

useCases.title: Index Fragmentation Maintenance Priority
useCases.value: Ranks indexes by fragmentation × page_count to schedule rebuilds during maintenance windows. Extends UC-7.1.9 with prioritization score.

useCases.title: Temp Tablespace Usage (Oracle TEMP)
useCases.value: High `TEMP` usage for sorts and hashes causes ORA-1652. Tracks session temp consumption vs temp tablespace limits.

useCases.title: Query Plan Regression (Runtime vs Baseline)
useCases.value: Compares current average CPU/duration from Query Store or AWR to baselines by `query_id`/`plan_hash`. Tightens UC-7.1.14 with explicit baseline lookup.

useCases.title: Database Patch Compliance
useCases.value: Compares instance `@@VERSION` / `banner` / Oracle `DBA_REGISTRY_HISTORY` to approved patch levels per environment. Supports security patching SLAs.

useCases.title: Database Audit Log Tampering Detection
useCases.value: Detects unexpected audit trail disable, audit file deletion, or Unified Audit policy changes that may indicate cover-up activity.

useCases.title: Cluster Membership Changes
useCases.value: Node additions/removals affect data distribution and availability. Unexpected membership changes may indicate failures.

useCases.title: Replication Lag / Consistency
useCases.value: Replication lag causes stale reads and eventual consistency violations. Monitoring ensures data freshness SLAs are met.

useCases.title: Read/Write Latency Trending
useCases.value: Latency trending detects performance degradation before it impacts users. Enables proactive tuning and scaling decisions.

useCases.title: Shard Imbalance Detection
useCases.value: Uneven shard distribution causes hot spots and performance inconsistency. Rebalancing prevents overloaded nodes.

useCases.title: Compaction Monitoring
useCases.value: Pending compactions consume I/O and can cause write amplification. Monitoring ensures compaction keeps pace with writes.

useCases.title: GC Pause Detection
useCases.value: Long GC pauses in Java-based databases (Cassandra, Elasticsearch) cause request timeouts and can trigger node eviction from the cluster.

useCases.title: Connection Count Monitoring
useCases.value: Approaching connection limits causes client rejections. Monitoring enables proactive limit adjustment or connection pooling.

useCases.title: Index Build Monitoring
useCases.value: Index builds consume significant resources and can impact production performance. Tracking ensures builds complete within maintenance windows.

useCases.title: Memory Utilization
useCases.value: NoSQL databases are memory-intensive. Evictions indicate undersized cache, causing disk reads and performance degradation.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Cluster Health
useCases.value: Elasticsearch cluster status directly indicates data availability. Yellow/red status requires immediate attention to prevent data loss.

useCases.title: MongoDB Oplog Window
useCases.value: Oplog window shrinking indicates replication at risk of falling behind. Exhausted oplog causes replica set members to resync from scratch (full resync), causing extended downtime.

useCases.title: MongoDB WiredTiger Cache Pressure
useCases.value: Cache dirty/used ratio approaching eviction thresholds causes increased disk I/O and degraded query performance. Early detection enables cache sizing or workload tuning.

app: MongoDB Atlas API / Atlas App Services webhook
useCases.title: MongoDB Atlas Cluster Alerts
useCases.value: Atlas project alerts (CPU, connections, replication) forwarded to Splunk provide a single pane with on-prem MongoDB. Rapid correlation during incidents.

useCases.title: Cassandra Compaction Backlog and Throughput
useCases.value: Pending compactions and compaction throughput indicate whether the cluster keeps up with writes. Complements generic compaction UC with nodetool-derived rates.

useCases.title: Redis Memory Fragmentation (Cache Tier)
useCases.value: High `mem_fragmentation_ratio` on self-managed Redis (not only ElastiCache) wastes RAM and increases latency. Tracks non-cloud Redis clusters in the NoSQL section.

useCases.title: DynamoDB Throttling Events
useCases.value: Read/write throttle events mean application retries and latency spikes. Identifies hot partitions and undersized capacity modes.

useCases.title: CouchDB Replication Conflicts
useCases.value: Growing `_conflicts` document count indicates divergent replicas and data quality issues. Early detection prevents silent wrong reads.

useCases.title: MongoDB Oplog Window Sufficiency
useCases.value: Validates minimum oplog window hours against replica catch-up time under peak load. Extends oplog monitoring with capacity-style thresholds per deployment class.

useCases.title: Cassandra Tombstone Accumulation
useCases.value: High tombstone counts per read and GC pressure slow queries and repairs. Monitoring `TombstoneHistogram` and read repair backlog prevents timeouts.

useCases.title: Redis Eviction Rate
useCases.value: Rising `evicted_keys` per second indicates memory pressure and cache miss storms. Distinct from fragmentation and hit ratio for ops response.

useCases.title: HBase RegionServer Failover Events
useCases.value: RegionServer death and region reassignment cause latency spikes and possible unavailability. Log and metric correlation speeds recovery.

useCases.title: CouchDB View Build Times
useCases.value: Long-running view index builds block compaction and increase disk I/O. Tracks `_active_tasks` indexer progress and failures.

useCases.title: MongoDB Index Inefficiency (Usage vs Size)
useCases.value: Indexes with near-zero `accesses.ops` and large `size` waste RAM and slow writes. Identifies candidates for drop or partial indexes.

useCases.title: RDS/Aurora Performance Insights
useCases.value: Performance Insights identifies top SQL and wait events without agent installation. Enables rapid diagnosis of managed database bottlenecks.

useCases.title: Automated Failover Events
useCases.value: Managed database failovers cause brief outages. Detection enables impact analysis and root cause investigation.

useCases.title: Read Replica Lag
useCases.value: Replica lag affects read consistency for applications using read replicas. Monitoring prevents stale data serving.

useCases.title: Storage Auto-Scaling Events
useCases.value: Tracks storage auto-scaling events for cost awareness and identifies databases with rapid growth needing attention.

useCases.title: Maintenance Window Tracking
useCases.value: Awareness of upcoming and completed maintenance ensures teams are prepared for potential service impact.

useCases.title: Redis Memory Fragmentation Ratio
useCases.value: Fragmentation ratio > 1.5 indicating memory inefficiency. High fragmentation wastes RAM and can trigger OOM or evictions under memory pressure.

useCases.title: Redis Keyspace Hit / Miss Ratio
useCases.value: Cache effectiveness trending. Low hit ratio indicates cache is not serving requests effectively, increasing load on backing stores.

useCases.title: Aurora Serverless Scaling Events
useCases.value: ACU (capacity unit) scale-up/down events explain latency and cost. Tracks whether scaling policy matches workload bursts.

useCases.title: Azure Cosmos DB RU Consumption
useCases.value: Normalized RU/s consumption vs provisioned throughput identifies hot partitions and autoscale effectiveness.

useCases.title: Cloud Spanner Instance Health
useCases.value: CPU utilization, hot spots, and replication delay for Spanner nodes indicate risk of write/read stalls on globally distributed data.

useCases.title: Managed Database Failover Events (Multi-Cloud)
useCases.value: Single search across RDS failover, Azure SQL failover, and Cloud SQL failover for hybrid teams. Supplements UC-7.3.2 with normalized fields.

useCases.title: Azure SQL Database DTU Exhaustion
useCases.value: DTU/vCore saturation causes throttling and query timeouts. Distinct from generic RDS CPU for Azure-only deployments.

useCases.title: Cloud SQL Storage Auto-Grow Events
useCases.value: Automatic storage increases for GCP Cloud SQL (and similar) signal rapid data growth and cost impact.

useCases.title: Managed Backup Retention Compliance
useCases.value: Verifies automated backup snapshots exist within required retention for RDS, Azure SQL LTR, and Cloud SQL backups.

useCases.title: Read Replica Lag Trending (Percentiles)
useCases.value: p95/p99 replica lag exposes tail behavior missed by max-only dashboards. Applies to RDS, Aurora, and Azure read replicas.

useCases.title: Azure SQL Managed Instance Resource Utilization
useCases.value: SQL Managed Instance provides near-100% SQL Server compatibility in Azure. CPU, storage I/O, and memory pressure against provisioned limits directly impact query performance and can cause throttling.

useCases.title: Azure SQL Managed Instance Failover Group Status
useCases.value: Failover groups provide geo-redundancy for SQL Managed Instance. Monitoring replication lag and failover events ensures disaster recovery readiness and detects unplanned failovers.

useCases.title: Query Performance Trending
useCases.value: Identifies expensive and slow queries impacting warehouse performance and cost. Enables query optimization and cost reduction.

useCases.title: Cluster Scaling Events
useCases.value: Tracks auto-scaling decisions for cost optimization. Identifies whether current scaling policies match workload patterns.

useCases.title: Data Pipeline Health
useCases.value: Failed or delayed ETL/ELT pipelines cause stale data for reporting and analytics. Early detection prevents downstream impact.

useCases.title: Credit / Cost per Query
useCases.value: Directly ties compute cost to individual queries, enabling chargeback and cost optimization. Identifies runaway queries consuming excessive resources.

useCases.title: Warehouse Utilization
useCases.value: Right-sizing warehouses reduces cost while maintaining performance. Utilization data drives scaling policy decisions.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Cluster Health and Shard Status
useCases.value: Red/yellow cluster, unassigned shards, and JVM pressure indicate data availability risk. Early detection prevents data loss and service degradation.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Index Size and Document Count Trending
useCases.value: Growth forecasting for indices enables proactive storage provisioning and index lifecycle management (ILM) tuning.

useCases.title: ClickHouse Query Performance
useCases.value: Merge operations, insert rate, and query duration indicate system health. Monitoring enables tuning and capacity planning for analytical workloads.

useCases.title: Snowflake Warehouse Credit Usage
useCases.value: Credits consumed per warehouse and role drive chargeback and right-sizing. Spikes indicate runaway queries or undersized warehouses thrashing.

useCases.title: Databricks Cluster Utilization
useCases.value: Cluster DBU hours, worker counts, and idle time reveal over-provisioned pools and jobs that keep clusters alive unnecessarily.

useCases.title: Redshift Query Queue Depth
useCases.value: WLM queue length and max execution time show concurrency saturation. Growing queue depth precedes disk-based spills and timeouts.

useCases.title: BigQuery Cost Anomalies
useCases.value: Sudden jumps in bytes billed or slot usage often trace to one bad query or new scheduled job. Statistical alerting limits surprise invoices.

useCases.title: Snowflake Query Spillage (Bytes Spilled to Local/Remote Storage)
useCases.value: Spillage indicates insufficient warehouse size or poorly written queries (exploding joins). Drives warehouse tier and query tuning decisions.

useCases.title: Databricks Job Failure Rate
useCases.value: Failed notebook/jar jobs block downstream analytics. Failure rate by job name prioritizes fixes for critical pipelines.

useCases.title: Azure Synapse Analytics SQL Pool Performance
useCases.value: Synapse dedicated SQL pools have DWU-based resource limits. Queries competing for resources cause queueing, and tempdb contention degrades batch processing. Monitoring ensures analytics workloads meet SLAs.

useCases.title: Azure Synapse Pipeline Execution Health
useCases.value: Synapse pipelines orchestrate data movement and transformation. Failed pipeline runs cause stale analytics data, broken reports, and missed business deadlines.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Cluster Health (Red / Yellow)
useCases.value: Yellow or red cluster status means primary/replica shards are not fully allocated; search and indexing can fail or degrade. Catching status changes early limits user impact.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Shard Allocation Failures
useCases.value: Unassigned or stuck relocating shards leave data unavailable or at risk; allocation explain output points to disk, routing, or settings issues before outages spread.

useCases.title: OpenSearch Index Performance
useCases.value: Slow merges, refresh intervals, and segment counts drive query latency and heap use; tracking per-index stats keeps search SLAs achievable.

useCases.title: OpenSearch Search Latency
useCases.value: P95/P99 query latency directly affects application UX; separating queue time from query time narrows tuning to thread pools vs. mappings and shards.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Indexing Rate Monitoring
useCases.value: A sudden drop in docs/s indexed can signal pipeline failures, bulk rejections, or cluster overload; sustained spikes may require scaling or throttling.

useCases.title: Solr Query Cache Hit Ratio
useCases.value: Low filter/query cache hit rates increase CPU and latency; tuning caches and queries improves headroom without adding nodes.

useCases.title: Solr Replication Lag
useCases.value: Followers lagging behind leaders serve stale results and extend recovery time; catching replication gaps protects read consistency and failover readiness.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Disk Watermark Alerts
useCases.value: Elasticsearch blocks shard allocation when flood-stage watermarks are hit; proactive disk alerts prevent read-only indices and cluster yellow/red states.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch JVM Heap Pressure
useCases.value: High heap usage and frequent GC pause search and indexing and can trigger circuit breakers; JVM trends predict node instability before restarts.

useCases.title: OpenSearch Snapshot / Backup Status
useCases.value: Failed or missing snapshots break restore and compliance RPO; monitoring repository and snapshot completion protects against silent backup gaps.

app: Elasticsearch slow logs / server logs forwarded to Splunk
useCases.title: Elasticsearch Circuit Breaker Trips
useCases.value: Circuit breaker exceptions stop requests to protect the cluster; repeated trips indicate oversized aggregations, mapping issues, or undersized heap.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Thread Pool Rejections
useCases.value: Thread pool rejections (HTTP 429) mean the cluster cannot keep up with search or indexing load. Sustained rejections cause data loss on ingest and timeouts on search.

app: Elasticsearch slow logs forwarded to Splunk
useCases.title: Elasticsearch Search Latency and Slow Queries
useCases.value: Search latency trending detects degradation before users notice. Slow log analysis identifies expensive queries for optimization.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch ILM Policy Failures
useCases.value: Failed ILM transitions leave indices in the wrong lifecycle phase — hot data stays on expensive storage, old data never deletes, rollover stops creating new indices. Silent failures accumulate until disk fills.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Snapshot Failures
useCases.value: Failed snapshots mean no viable backup for disaster recovery. Partial snapshots may leave indices unrecoverable. Monitoring ensures RPO commitments are met.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Cross-Cluster Replication Lag
useCases.value: CCR follower lag directly impacts disaster recovery readiness. Excessive lag means a failover would lose recent data. Monitoring ensures replication SLAs are met.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Pending Cluster Tasks
useCases.value: A growing backlog of pending cluster tasks indicates the master node cannot process cluster state updates fast enough. This delays shard allocation, mapping updates, and index creation.
