Connection, authentication, posture, and disconnect-reason events show who cannot reach applications and why — distinguishing client bugs, credential issues, MFA failures, and policy blocks without guessing from help-desk anecdotes.

useCases.title: Cato DLP and CASB Event Analysis (Cato Networks)
useCases.value: Inline CASB and DLP inspect cloud application traffic for unsanctioned SaaS, sensitive data movement, and policy violations in one SASE pass. Aggregating these events highlights shadow IT growth, risky uploads, and repeat offenders before data leaves the organization’s control.

useCases.title: Netskope Cloud App Risk Assessment
useCases.value: Netskope assigns Cloud Confidence Index (CCI) scores to SaaS applications. Tracking high-risk (low CCI) app usage reveals shadow IT and data exposure. Trending CCI across the organization supports SaaS governance and vendor risk management.

useCases.title: Netskope DLP Policy Violations
useCases.value: Netskope inline DLP inspects uploads, downloads, and cloud-to-cloud sharing for sensitive data (PII, PCI, PHI, IP). Tracking violations by policy, user, and destination app identifies repeat offenders, miscategorized data, and policy gaps before a breach.

useCases.title: Netskope Threat Protection Events
useCases.value: Netskope inspects web and cloud traffic for malware, phishing, and exploits inline. Threat events reveal attack vectors targeting users through sanctioned and unsanctioned cloud apps — a blind spot for traditional perimeter firewalls.

useCases.title: Netskope SWG Web Category Blocking
useCases.value: Tracks blocked web requests by URL category across the Netskope SWG — tunes real-time policy and validates acceptable-use enforcement for remote and office users alike.

useCases.title: Netskope Private Access (NPA) Health
useCases.value: Netskope Private Access (NPA) is the ZTNA component — replacing VPN for private application access. Publisher (connector) health, error rates, and latency determine whether users can reach internal apps.

useCases.title: Netskope CASB Inline Policy Enforcement
useCases.value: Netskope CASB enforces activity-level policies on sanctioned SaaS apps (block upload, read-only, quarantine). Monitoring enforcement actions validates that cloud governance policies are working and identifies gaps.

useCases.title: Netskope Admin Audit Trail
useCases.value: Administrative changes to Netskope policies, steering configs, and tenant settings have global impact. Audit trail ensures accountability and change correlation.

app: TA-fortinet_fortigate (FortiSASE logs use FortiGate syslog format)
useCases.title: FortiSASE SWG Policy Violation Trends (Fortinet)
useCases.value: FortiSASE cloud-delivered SWG enforces web filtering for remote and branch users through FortiGate NGFW policies in the cloud. Trending blocked categories and rules identifies policy drift and shadow IT.

useCases.title: FortiSASE ZTNA Application Access (Fortinet)
useCases.value: FortiSASE ZTNA tags replace traditional VPN by granting per-application access based on device posture and identity. Monitoring ZTNA tag matches and application access patterns validates zero-trust enforcement.

useCases.title: FortiSASE Threat Detection Events (Fortinet)
useCases.value: FortiSASE applies IPS, anti-malware, and sandboxing inline for all users. Threat events reveal attack vectors bypassing traditional perimeter security — critical for remote-first organizations.

useCases.title: FortiSASE Thin Edge Health (Fortinet)
useCases.value: FortiSASE thin edges (FortiExtender, FortiGate in SASE mode) connect branches to the nearest FortiSASE PoP. Tunnel state, latency, and failover events determine branch connectivity and SLA compliance.

useCases.title: FortiSASE Admin Configuration Audit (Fortinet)
useCases.value: FortiSASE policies are centrally managed and affect all connected users globally. Configuration audit logs enable change tracking, compliance, and root-cause analysis when policies cause access issues.

app: CCX Add-on for Checkpoint Smart-1 Cloud (Splunkbase 7259)
useCases.title: Check Point Harmony SASE Threat Prevention (Check Point)
useCases.value: Check Point Harmony SASE applies ThreatCloud AI-powered prevention (IPS, anti-malware, anti-bot, threat emulation) to all user traffic via cloud enforcement points. Detection events reveal threats targeting users regardless of location.

useCases.title: Check Point Harmony SASE Internet Access Policy (Check Point)
useCases.value: Harmony SASE Internet Access (formerly Perimeter 81) enforces URL filtering, application control, and content inspection. Tracking policy actions validates acceptable-use enforcement and identifies shadow IT.

useCases.title: Check Point Harmony SASE Private Access (Check Point)
useCases.value: Harmony SASE Private Access (ZTNA) grants per-application access to private resources without VPN. Connector health, access decisions, and latency determine user experience for internal applications.

useCases.title: Check Point Harmony SASE Admin Audit (Check Point)
useCases.value: Centralized SASE policy changes affect all connected users and sites. Audit logs enable compliance, change correlation, and accountability.

app: CCX Add-on for Checkpoint Smart-1 Cloud (Splunkbase 7259)
useCases.title: Check Point Harmony SASE DLP Events (Check Point)
useCases.value: Harmony SASE inline DLP inspects uploads and downloads for sensitive data patterns (credit cards, SSNs, health records, source code). Detection events identify data exposure risks across cloud and private application access.

useCases.title: Akamai Guardicore Segmentation Policy Violations
useCases.value: Akamai Guardicore enforces microsegmentation at the workload level across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments. Policy violation events (blocked lateral movement) validate that default-deny segmentation is enforced and detect attempted east-west attacks.

useCases.title: Akamai Guardicore Reveal Map Anomalies
useCases.value: Guardicore's Reveal feature maps all process-level communication between workloads. New or unexpected connections that deviate from the learned application dependency map may indicate lateral movement, compromised workloads, or configuration drift.

useCases.title: Akamai Guardicore Agent Health
useCases.value: Guardicore agents on workloads enforce segmentation policies. Offline or degraded agents leave workloads unprotected — effectively disabling zero trust enforcement on that asset.

useCases.title: Akamai Guardicore Incident Investigation
useCases.value: Guardicore generates security incidents when patterns of blocked connections, deception (honeypot) triggers, or policy violations suggest active threats. Incident-level correlation in Splunk supports rapid investigation with full process and network context.

useCases.title: Broadcom Symantec Cloud SWG Policy Analysis (Broadcom)
useCases.value: Broadcom Symantec Cloud SWG (formerly WSS) provides cloud-delivered web security with URL filtering, threat protection, and SSL inspection for all users. Tracking policy violations and threat blocks validates security posture.

useCases.title: Broadcom Symantec CASB Shadow IT Detection (Broadcom)
useCases.value: Symantec CloudSOC CASB detects unsanctioned cloud application usage by analyzing web proxy and firewall logs. Shadow IT visibility identifies data exposure risks and supports SaaS governance.

useCases.title: Broadcom Symantec Cloud SWG Threat Events (Broadcom)
useCases.value: Cloud SWG detects malware, phishing, and zero-day threats via URL reputation, content analysis, and sandboxing. Threat events in Splunk enable incident response and threat hunting.

useCases.title: Cloudflare Access (ZTNA) Policy Enforcement
useCases.value: Cloudflare Access replaces VPN with per-application zero-trust access policies based on identity, device posture, and network context. Tracking allow/block decisions validates that access policies are correctly enforced.

useCases.title: Cloudflare Gateway (SWG) DNS and HTTP Filtering
useCases.value: Cloudflare Gateway provides DNS-layer and HTTP-layer filtering for all users. DNS blocks stop threats before connections are established; HTTP inspection enforces content and application policies.

useCases.title: Cloudflare Tunnel Health
useCases.value: Cloudflare Tunnels (formerly Argo Tunnels) connect private infrastructure to Cloudflare without opening inbound ports. Tunnel health determines whether users can reach private applications through Cloudflare Access.

useCases.title: Forcepoint ONE SSE Web Security Events (Forcepoint)
useCases.value: Forcepoint ONE SSE delivers cloud-native SWG, CASB, and ZTNA from a unified platform. Web security events reveal policy violations, threat blocks, and shadow IT usage across all users.

useCases.title: Forcepoint ONE ZTNA Private Access Health (Forcepoint)
useCases.value: Forcepoint ONE ZTNA provides agentless and agent-based private application access. Connector health and access decision monitoring ensures application reachability.

useCases.title: SonicWall Cloud SWG and SMA Access Events (SonicWall)
useCases.value: SonicWall Cloud SWG and Secure Mobile Access (SMA) provide cloud-delivered web security and ZTNA for remote and branch users. Tracking blocked connections, authentication events, and policy actions validates secure access enforcement.

app: Versa Networks Splunk App (via Versa Analytics syslog integration)
useCases.title: Versa SASE Security and Access Events (Versa Networks)
useCases.value: Versa SASE unifies SD-WAN, SWG, CASB, ZTNA, and FWaaS in a single platform. Security event analysis across these functions provides unified threat visibility and policy enforcement validation.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Fabric Health Score Monitoring
useCases.value: ACI fabric health scores provide a single-pane view of overall data center network health. Monitoring these scores lets you catch degradation before it impacts workloads, correlate health drops with specific faults, and maintain SLA compliance across your data center fabric.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Fault Trending by Severity
useCases.value: ACI faults are the primary operational signal from the fabric. Trending faults by severity helps identify worsening conditions, recurring hardware issues, and configuration problems before they cascade into outages.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Endpoint Mobility Tracking
useCases.value: Endpoint mobility in ACI tracks workload movement across leaf switches. Anomalous mobility (rapid moves, unexpected locations) can indicate misconfigurations, loops, or security issues like MAC spoofing.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Contract/Filter Hit Analysis
useCases.value: ACI contracts control EPG-to-EPG communication. Analyzing contract hits reveals traffic patterns, identifies overly permissive or unused contracts, and helps validate micro-segmentation policies are working as designed.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Tenant Configuration Audit
useCases.value: Configuration changes in ACI tenants (BDs, EPGs, contracts) are a leading cause of outages. Auditing all changes provides accountability, supports compliance, and enables rapid rollback identification when issues occur.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Leaf/Spine Interface Utilization
useCases.value: Fabric link saturation causes packet drops and application latency. Monitoring leaf/spine interface utilization identifies hotspots, validates ECMP distribution, and supports capacity planning for fabric expansion.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: APIC Cluster Health
useCases.value: APIC controllers manage the entire ACI fabric. Cluster health issues (split-brain, leader election, convergence problems) can cause fabric-wide configuration and policy failures. Monitoring APIC cluster state is essential for fabric reliability.

useCases.title: Spine-Leaf Fabric Latency
useCases.value: Inter-switch latency within the fabric directly impacts east-west traffic between workloads. High latency causes application timeouts, database replication lag, and degraded user experience. Monitoring fabric latency identifies congestion, misrouted traffic, and capacity bottlenecks before they impact SLAs.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: ACI Contract Hit/Miss Ratio Analysis
useCases.value: Complements raw contract hits (UC-18.1.4) with **permit vs deny/miss** ratios over time to catch mis-tuned filters and unexpected drops before workloads fail.

useCases.title: ACI Endpoint Group (EPG) Health
useCases.value: Aggregates fault and health indicators per EPG (endpoint count, contract violations, BD binding) for application-centric status.

useCases.title: ACI Fault Lifecycle Tracking
useCases.value: Tracks fault `lc` (lifecycle: raising, active, retaining, resolved) and time-to-clear — beyond raw fault counts (UC-18.1.2).

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Fabric Node Decommission Events
useCases.value: Audits leaf/spine/APIC removal or disable operations for change control and capacity reconciliation.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Bridge Domain Subnet Utilization
useCases.value: Tracks IP usage vs subnet size per BD to prevent exhaustion of gateway pools and VM mobility issues.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: L3Out Prefix Monitoring
useCases.value: Monitors advertised/ learned prefixes on L3Outs (BGP/OSPF) for flapping, withdrawal storms, and unexpected route loss.

useCases.title: APIC Policy CAM Utilization
useCases.value: Tracks TCAM/CAM-style resource use for contracts and security policies on leaf nodes — exhaustion causes policy install failures.

useCases.title: ACI Tenant Configuration Compliance Audit
useCases.value: Checks tenants for required objects (vzAny restrictions, monitoring policies, SNMP/Syslog) — extends change audit (UC-18.1.5) with **policy completeness** scoring.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: ACI Multisite Health
useCases.value: Monitors inter-site control-plane sync, spine proxy, and state for Cisco ACI Multi-Site / Multi-Pod deployments.

useCases.title: APIC Cluster Replication Latency
useCases.value: Complements UC-18.1.7 with **database replication delay** and inter-APIC consensus metrics for split-brain prevention.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: ACI Fault Domain Severity Rollup
useCases.value: Fault domains group infrastructure and policy failures by functional area (for example connectivity, configuration, or capacity). Rolling up open faults by domain shows where the fabric is structurally weak, helps prioritize remediation before east-west traffic degrades, and shortens war-room triage during incidents.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Contract Violation and Implicit Deny Bursts
useCases.value: Sudden increases in implicit denies or contract violations usually mean a mis-deployed contract, a missing EPG binding, or an attack probing disallowed paths. Catching bursts early prevents application outages and avoids silent security gaps where traffic is dropped without operator visibility.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: EPG Endpoint Learning and Deletion Churn
useCases.value: Rapid endpoint learn/delete cycles on an EPG strain the control plane and can precede bridging or routing instability. Monitoring learning churn protects workload mobility designs and catches misconfigured duplicate IPs or spanning-tree interactions before they impact database and storage east-west paths.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Fabric Port-Channel and Member Link Imbalance
useCases.value: Uneven distribution across port-channel members defeats ECMP assumptions and can saturate individual uplinks while siblings stay idle. Detecting imbalance protects spine-leaf oversubscription models and avoids tail latency for storage and replication traffic.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: APIC Controller Resource Exhaustion Watch
useCases.value: APIC nodes host the policy repository and cluster services; disk, memory, or inode pressure delays policy pushes and can stall fault processing. Watching controller resources prevents brownouts where the fabric stays up but automation and incremental updates fail during change windows.

useCases.title: Distributed Firewall Rule Hits
useCases.value: NSX Distributed Firewall (DFW) runs on every hypervisor, providing east-west traffic control. Monitoring rule hits validates security policy effectiveness, identifies unused rules for cleanup, and detects policy violations in real time.

useCases.title: Micro-Segmentation Enforcement
useCases.value: NSX micro-segmentation is a key Zero Trust control. Monitoring enforcement validates that workloads are properly isolated, detects lateral movement attempts, and proves compliance with segmentation policies during audits.

useCases.title: Logical Switch Health
useCases.value: NSX logical switches and routers form the virtual network fabric. Monitoring their operational status ensures VM connectivity and helps identify overlay network issues before they impact applications.

useCases.title: NSX Edge Performance
useCases.value: NSX Edge nodes handle north-south traffic, load balancing, and NAT. Performance bottlenecks on Edge nodes directly impact application availability and throughput for any workload communicating outside the NSX fabric.

useCases.title: Transport Node Connectivity
useCases.value: Transport nodes are the hypervisors participating in the NSX overlay. Tunnel failures between transport nodes cause VM-to-VM communication loss across hosts, directly impacting application availability.

useCases.title: Distributed Firewall Rule Hit Rate Analysis
useCases.value: Baselines hits per DFW rule and flags sudden drops (unused or bypassed) or spikes (attack or misconfiguration) — complements UC-18.2.1 volume view.

useCases.title: Micro-Segmentation Policy Drift
useCases.value: Compares published DFW policy revision to approved baseline (lookup) to detect unauthorized rule changes between change windows.

useCases.title: NSX Edge Gateway Health
useCases.value: Service status for Tier-0/Tier-1 SR components (BGP, NAT, LB service) on Edge nodes — complements CPU metrics (UC-18.2.4).

useCases.title: NSX-T Transport Node Overlay Path Health
useCases.value: Validates GENEVE overlay between TNs (packet loss, MTU) beyond simple UP/DOWN (UC-18.2.5).

useCases.title: Load Balancer Pool Health
useCases.value: Monitors NSX Advanced Load Balancer / LB pool member up/down and health check failures for published apps.

useCases.title: NAT Rule Utilization
useCases.value: Tracks NAT session and port allocation per rule — prevents exhaustion on busy Edge gateways.

useCases.title: T0/T1 Gateway Failover Events
useCases.value: Captures active/standby transitions for Tier-0/Tier-1 logical routers for incident correlation and HA validation.

useCases.title: NSX Manager Cluster Health
useCases.value: Cluster quorum, Corfu/RAFT health, and API reachability for NSX Manager appliance cluster.

useCases.title: NSX Intelligence Top Flows and Anomalous East-West Volume
useCases.value: NSX Intelligence summarizes flow metadata across the overlay. Tracking dominant flows and sudden volume shifts highlights misconfigured services, lateral movement, or noisy neighbors before micro-segmentation rules are tuned, keeping data center east-west paths predictable for latency-sensitive tiers.

useCases.title: Distributed Firewall Rule Hit Counts by Application Tier
useCases.value: Grouping DFW hits by application tier proves which segmentation boundaries are exercised in production and identifies stale allow rules that see no traffic. This reduces attack surface during audits and prevents accidental removal of rules that still protect critical tiers.

useCases.title: Edge Cluster BFD and Uplink Session Health
useCases.value: Tier-0 edge clusters depend on BFD and stable uplinks for fast failure detection. Degraded BFD or partial uplink loss causes asymmetric north-south paths and intermittent application reachability. Proactive monitoring supports failover drills and prevents surprise brownouts during ISP maintenance.

useCases.title: Transport Node Data Plane Interface Errors and Drops
useCases.value: Overlay GENEVE depends on clean physical NICs and switch ports. Rising errors or drops on TN N-VDS or VDS uplinks manifest as intermittent VM connectivity and false-positive firewall symptoms. Isolating TN-level drops speeds root cause between server, rack, and fabric teams.

useCases.title: NSX Intelligence Recommended Firewall Rule Publish Queue
useCases.value: NSX Intelligence proposes micro-segmentation rules; a backed-up or failed publish queue delays enforcement of least-privilege changes and leaves temporary broad access in place. Monitoring queue depth ties security posture to operational SLAs for the data center network.

useCases.title: Cilium/Calico Network Policy Monitoring
useCases.value: Kubernetes CNI network policies enforce pod-to-pod communication rules. Monitoring policy enforcement validates that micro-segmentation is working in containerized environments, critical for multi-tenant clusters and compliance.

useCases.title: OpenStack Neutron Events
useCases.value: Neutron manages virtual networking in OpenStack. Tracking network operations (creation, modification, deletion) provides change audit, helps troubleshoot connectivity issues, and identifies unauthorized network modifications.

useCases.title: SDN Controller Health
useCases.value: SDN controllers are the brain of software-defined networks. Controller outages or cluster consensus failures can cause network-wide disruption. Monitoring controller health ensures the control plane remains available and consistent.

useCases.title: VXLAN Tunnel and Overlay Health
useCases.value: VXLAN tunnel failures break overlay connectivity. Monitoring tunnel state and packet drops ensures fabric reliability and fast troubleshooting.

useCases.title: EVPN Route and MAC Mobility Events
useCases.value: EVPN route churn or MAC mobility storms can impact convergence and stability. Tracking route and mobility events supports fabric tuning and VM mobility analysis.

useCases.title: ACI Contract Deny and Drop Statistics
useCases.value: High contract deny or drop counts may indicate overly restrictive policy or attack traffic. Monitoring supports policy tuning and security analysis.

useCases.title: NSX-T Segment and Gateway Capacity
useCases.value: Segment or gateway overload affects tenant connectivity and performance. Monitoring capacity and utilization supports scale planning and troubleshooting.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: SDN Configuration Change and Rollback Audit
useCases.value: Unauthorized fabric or policy changes can cause outages or security gaps. Auditing changes and rollbacks supports change control and incident analysis.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: VXLAN VTEP Reachability
useCases.value: VTEP (VXLAN Tunnel Endpoint) peers form the overlay mesh in VXLAN fabrics. When a VTEP goes down, tenant segments lose connectivity and workloads become isolated. Monitoring VTEP reachability ensures overlay health and enables rapid detection of NVE failures before tenant impact.

useCases.title: EVPN Route Type Distribution
useCases.value: EVPN route table growth (Type-2 MAC/IP and Type-5 IP prefix routes) impacts control-plane memory and convergence time. Trending route counts by type supports capacity planning, identifies runaway growth (e.g., VM sprawl, IP prefix leakage), and helps size fabric hardware for future scale.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: EVPN/VXLAN Tunnel Health
useCases.value: Unified view of BGP EVPN tunnel state and VXLAN encapsulation errors per VNI — bridges overlay protocols (complements UC-18.3.4 and UC-18.3.9).

useCases.title: SDN Controller High Availability
useCases.value: Quorum, leader election, and data-store sync for controller clusters — extends generic health (UC-18.3.3) with **HA-specific** failover signals.

useCases.title: Fabric Upgrade Compliance
useCases.value: Tracks switch OS / ACI firmware versions against approved upgrade wave — identifies stragglers and unsupported trains.

useCases.title: Spine-Leaf Topology Anomalies
useCases.value: Detects unexpected BGP neighbor loss, missing spine links, or asymmetric ECMP paths in Clos topology.

useCases.title: BGP EVPN Route Table Convergence
useCases.value: Measures time-to-stable route count after churn events (link bounce, leaf reboot) — complements route count trending (UC-18.3.10).

useCases.title: VTEP Reachability and Loss
useCases.value: Packet loss and latency between VTEP peers — augments UC-18.3.9 state-only checks.

useCases.title: Leaf Switch Resource Utilization
useCases.value: CPU, memory, and forwarding table use on leaf switches — prevents control-plane overload and FIB exhaustion.

useCases.title: BGP EVPN Route Withdrawal Rate and Flap Storms
useCases.value: Withdrawal storms shrink effective ECMP sets and extend convergence after link or node events, which shows up as application timeouts and storage path loss. Measuring withdrawal velocity per peer differentiates normal housekeeping from dangerous churn in the EVPN control plane.

useCases.title: Spine-Leaf ECMP Member Utilization Balance
useCases.value: ECMP assumes balanced hashing across parallel paths; persistent skew overloads individual spine uplinks while others remain idle. Monitoring member utilization protects oversubscribed Clos designs and avoids silent drops when one path saturates during backup or replication waves.

useCases.title: Fabric Host Route and ARP Scale Headroom
useCases.value: EVPN Type-2 host routes and ARP scale drive TCAM and forwarding table use on leafs. Running out of headroom stalls new workload placement and causes black-holed traffic during scale-out events. Trending utilization against hardware limits informs purchase timing and route summarization design.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: EVPN Ethernet Segment (ESI) DF Election and BUM Stability
useCases.value: All-active multihoming depends on correct designated forwarder election and stable per-ESI state. DF flaps or split-brain indicators disrupt BUM handling and can isolate VLANs for dual-homed hosts. Early detection protects clustered databases and hypervisor trunks.

useCases.title: VXLAN Underlay Path MTU and DF Bit Fragmentation Risk
useCases.value: VXLAN adds overhead; MTU mismatches or PMTUD black holes cause silent throughput collapse and TCP retransmits on east-west paths. Tracking DF-bit probes and ICMP unreachables across the underlay separates fabric issues from guest OS misconfiguration before tickets flood application teams.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Nexus Dashboard Insights Anomaly Monitoring
useCases.value: Nexus Dashboard Insights (NDI) uses ML-driven baselining to detect anomalies across hardware, capacity, compliance, connectivity, and configuration. Forwarding these anomalies to Splunk enables correlation with application and security events that NDI cannot see, and provides long-term trending beyond NDI retention.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: NDFC Fabric Compliance and Configuration Drift
useCases.value: NDFC enforces intended configuration via templates. Detecting drift between running config and intended config across the fabric prevents misconfigurations that cause outages, security gaps, or inconsistent policy enforcement.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Nexus Dashboard Advisory and Field Notice Alerts
useCases.value: Nexus Dashboard Insights identifies field notices, PSIRTs, and hardware advisories that affect switches in the fabric by matching device serial numbers and software versions. Forwarding these to Splunk provides a centralised risk view alongside other infrastructure advisories.

useCases.title: Nexus 9000 NX-OS Streaming Telemetry Health
useCases.value: Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC) from Nexus 9000 provides sub-second interface, routing, and system metrics. Monitoring the telemetry pipeline itself ensures data collection gaps are detected before they blind monitoring dashboards.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: NX-OS VXLAN EVPN Fabric Underlay BGP Health
useCases.value: The VXLAN EVPN fabric relies on BGP for both underlay (iBGP/OSPF) and overlay (BGP EVPN address family) connectivity. BGP peer flaps or stuck sessions in the underlay break VTEP reachability and cause tenant network outages. Monitoring BGP state across all spines and leafs is foundational.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: NX-OS Control Plane Policing (CoPP) Drops
useCases.value: CoPP protects the switch CPU from being overwhelmed by excessive control-plane traffic (ARP storms, BGP attacks, ICMP floods). Monitoring CoPP drop counters detects both legitimate overload and potential DoS attacks targeting the management or routing plane.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Nexus Dashboard Orchestrator Cross-Fabric Consistency
useCases.value: Nexus Dashboard Orchestrator (NDO, formerly MSO) manages policies across multiple ACI fabrics or NDFC-managed NX-OS fabrics. Configuration inconsistencies between sites cause asymmetric routing, broken inter-site connectivity, and policy enforcement gaps.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: NDFC Switch Inventory and Lifecycle Status
useCases.value: Maintaining an accurate, up-to-date inventory of all switches managed by NDFC, including model, serial, software version, and end-of-life/end-of-support dates, supports procurement planning, compliance audits, and vulnerability management.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Nexus Dashboard Site and Fabric Assurance Health Score
useCases.value: Site-level assurance scores roll up connectivity, best-practice violations, and capacity risk across all managed switches. Surfacing declining scores in Splunk gives data center operators a single trend line to prioritize remediation before Insights opens critical anomalies during business peaks.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Golden Firmware Image Compliance Across NDFC Fabrics
useCases.value: Running multiple NX-OS trains in one fabric increases interoperability defects during upgrades. Comparing live images to the approved golden list per platform reduces unplanned reload risk and speeds security patch campaigns for the physical data center network.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: NDFC Flow Telemetry Drop and Export Health
useCases.value: Flow telemetry underpins capacity and security analytics for the NX-OS fabric. Collector drops or stalled exports create blind spots where congestion and microbursts go unseen until applications complain. Monitoring pipeline health preserves trust in east-west utilization dashboards.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: Nexus Dashboard Insights Alert Noise and Category Mix
useCases.value: Insights can generate bursts of correlated alerts after a single root cause. Tracking alert volume by category separates chronic noise from emerging systemic issues and helps tune NDI policies without losing visibility into real data center network regressions.

app: Cisco DC Networking Application for Splunk
useCases.title: NDFC POAP / ZTP Bootstrap and Day-0 Onboarding Failures
useCases.value: Automated provisioning brings switches into the fabric quickly; DHCP, image fetch, or certificate failures during POAP/ZTP delay expansions and leave partially configured devices in racks. Monitoring onboarding outcomes keeps brownfield growth on schedule and prevents rogue devices from sitting outside policy.

useCases.title: Blade/Rack Server Health (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: A degraded DIMM or PSU often precedes an uncorrectable ECC error or power loss event. Proactive FRU RMA before HA capacity is exhausted on remaining paths prevents unplanned workload migration and potential data unavailability.

useCases.title: Service Profile Compliance (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: UCS service profiles define the identity of compute resources. Non-compliant associations indicate configuration drift, failed hardware migrations, or policy violations that can impact workload performance and security.

useCases.title: Firmware Compliance (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: Running inconsistent firmware across UCS creates compatibility issues and security vulnerabilities. Tracking firmware versions enables compliance reporting, patch planning, and ensures consistency across the compute fleet.

useCases.title: Fault Trending by Severity (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: UCS fault trends reveal systemic hardware issues, environmental problems, or configuration problems across the compute fleet. Rising fault counts indicate deteriorating conditions requiring proactive attention.

useCases.title: FI Port Channel Health
useCases.value: Fabric Interconnects are the network gateway for all UCS compute. Port-channel failures reduce bandwidth or cause complete loss of connectivity, impacting every workload in the UCS domain.

useCases.title: Power and Thermal Monitoring (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: UCS power and thermal data helps optimize data center capacity planning, detect cooling failures before overheating causes server throttling, and track energy efficiency metrics for sustainability reporting.

useCases.title: Blade Firmware Compliance (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: Per-blade firmware (BIOS, adapter, storage controller) vs approved bundles — complements fleet-wide inventory (UC-19.1.3) with **per-blade** tracking for change windows.

useCases.title: Service Profile Association Failures (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: Failed or stuck service profile associations block server bring-up and maintenance — complements compliance state (UC-19.1.2).

useCases.title: Fault Suppression Policy Audit (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: Tracks suppressed or acknowledged faults that may hide recurring hardware issues — governance for suppression rules.

useCases.title: FI Port Channel Member Errors and CRCs
useCases.value: Per-member link errors and CRCs on FI port-channels — augments aggregate PC status (UC-19.1.5).

useCases.title: UCS Manager Backup Validation
useCases.value: Confirms scheduled all/configuration backups completed and file size is within expected bounds.

useCases.title: Chassis PSU Redundancy
useCases.value: Detects loss of N+1 PSU redundancy in chassis before full power loss.

useCases.title: IOM Uplink Utilization
useCases.value: IOM-to-FI uplink saturation causes east-west congestion for blade traffic.

useCases.title: BIOS Policy Compliance
useCases.value: Verifies server BIOS settings match service profile BIOS policy (VT-x, power management, boot mode).

useCases.title: UCS Central Registration Health
useCases.value: Monitors UCS domain registration and heartbeat to UCS Central for multi-domain governance.

useCases.title: Intersight Server Alarm Monitoring
useCases.value: Intersight centralises alarms across all managed UCS domains, IMM and classic. Monitoring alarm severity trends in Splunk enables faster triage and correlation with application-layer events that Intersight alone cannot see.

useCases.title: Intersight Firmware Compliance
useCases.value: Intersight tracks firmware versions against policies for all managed endpoints. Surfacing non-compliant servers in Splunk alongside vulnerability data and change windows ensures patching cadence is maintained fleet-wide.

useCases.title: Intersight HCL Compliance Status
useCases.value: Hardware Compatibility List compliance ensures OS, driver, and firmware combinations are Cisco-validated. Non-HCL configurations risk unpredictable failures and void support entitlements.

useCases.title: Intersight Server Power and Thermal Telemetry
useCases.value: Power draw and thermal readings across the fleet feed capacity planning, detect cooling anomalies, and correlate with workload spikes. Trending helps predict rack-level power budget exhaustion.

useCases.title: Intersight Audit Log and Configuration Changes
useCases.value: Tracks every admin action and policy modification in Intersight. Correlating these with incident timelines reveals whether infrastructure changes contributed to outages or security events.

useCases.title: Intersight Contract and Warranty Compliance
useCases.value: Monitoring support contract and warranty expiration across the compute fleet prevents coverage gaps that delay RMA and increase risk during hardware failures.

useCases.title: UCS X-Series Intelligent Fabric Module Health
useCases.value: The X-Series Intelligent Fabric Modules (IFMs) replace traditional IOMs and provide Ethernet and management connectivity to every compute node in the chassis. IFM faults or link degradation can isolate entire chassis from the fabric.

useCases.title: Nutanix Prism Central Alert Monitoring
useCases.value: Cluster-wide alerts from Prism Central provide early warning of infrastructure issues across managed Nutanix clusters. Monitoring unresolved critical and warning alerts enables rapid response to capacity, hardware, and service degradation before it impacts workloads.

useCases.title: Nutanix AOS Version Compliance
useCases.value: Clusters running non-current AOS versions face compatibility risks, support limitations, and security gaps. Tracking version compliance enables upgrade planning, audit reporting, and ensures consistency across the Nutanix fleet.

useCases.title: Nutanix Snapshot Retention Compliance
useCases.value: Protection domain snapshots that exceed retention policy consume storage and increase backup window duration. Monitoring snapshot age and count identifies stale snapshots for cleanup, reduces storage waste, and ensures alignment with data protection policies.

useCases.title: Blade Server ECC Memory Error Rate (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: Correctable ECC errors often precede uncorrectable failures and guest crashes. Trending per-blade memory error rates lets you schedule DIMM replacement during maintenance windows instead of reacting to sudden hardware loss.

useCases.title: Rack Server PSU N+1 Redundancy (Cisco UCS C-Series)
useCases.value: A single failed PSU on a rack server without redundant feed leaves no margin before power loss. Tracking redundancy state across C-Series nodes preserves uptime for standalone HCI and database workloads.

useCases.title: Fabric Interconnect HA Cluster State
useCases.value: FI pairs provide control-plane and northbound redundancy. Loss of subordinate or split state risks asymmetric forwarding and prolonged change freezes until the fabric is healed.

useCases.title: CNA / vNIC Adapter Firmware Drift (Cisco UCS)
useCases.value: Adapter firmware out of sync with the approved bundle can cause intermittent FCoE/NVMe-oF or driver mismatches after OS upgrades. Per-adapter tracking closes gaps that aggregate inventory views miss.

useCases.title: Intersight Device Connector / Tunnel Health
useCases.value: If the secure connector or cloud tunnel is down, alarms and inventory stop updating while hardware may still be failing. Early detection preserves single-pane visibility before the operations team loses trust in the portal.

useCases.title: Chassis Thermal Runaway Risk (Blade Enclosures)
useCases.value: Rising inlet temperatures or falling fan speeds across a chassis precede thermal shutdown of multiple blades. Acting on enclosure-level trends protects dense compute before throttling spreads to tenant VMs.

useCases.title: IOM / FEX to FI Link Flap Events
useCases.value: Repeated link flaps between IOM/FEX and FI cause micro-outages for blade traffic and complicate troubleshooting with intermittent CRCs. Counting flaps per uplink highlights bad optics or mis-seated cables before full path loss.

useCases.title: Service Profile vNIC Redundancy and Failover Audit
useCases.value: A service profile with a single active vNIC or mismatched failover policy removes network redundancy for VMs. Auditing template-derived settings reduces surprise outages during single-path failures.

useCases.title: Cluster Health Monitoring
useCases.value: HCI cluster health directly determines workload availability. Monitoring overall cluster state, node availability, and service health enables rapid response to degradation before it impacts VMs and applications running on the cluster.

useCases.title: Storage Pool Capacity
useCases.value: HCI storage pools are shared across all workloads. Running out of storage capacity causes VM provisioning failures, snapshot failures, and ultimately VM crashes. Proactive monitoring and forecasting prevents capacity emergencies.

useCases.title: Storage I/O Latency
useCases.value: Storage latency directly impacts application performance on HCI. Elevated latency affects all VMs on the cluster. Early detection of latency spikes enables workload rebalancing or troubleshooting before user impact escalates.

useCases.title: Node Performance Balance
useCases.value: HCI relies on balanced workload distribution across nodes. Imbalanced nodes lead to hotspots where some nodes are overloaded while others are underutilized, reducing overall cluster efficiency and increasing failure risk.

useCases.title: Disk Failure Tracking
useCases.value: Disk failures in HCI trigger data rebuild operations that consume cluster resources and temporarily reduce resilience. Tracking failures enables rapid replacement, monitoring rebuild progress, and assessing the cluster's ability to tolerate additional failures.

useCases.title: Replication Factor Compliance
useCases.value: HCI data resilience depends on maintaining the configured replication factor (RF2/RF3). Non-compliant replication means data loss risk if additional failures occur. Monitoring RF compliance is essential for data protection assurance.

useCases.title: CVM (Controller VM) Health
useCases.value: Nutanix Controller VMs manage all storage I/O on each node. CVM failures cause I/O to redirect to other nodes, impacting performance. Monitoring CVM health ensures the HCI control plane remains operational across all nodes.

useCases.title: HCI Cluster Balance and Skew
useCases.value: Imbalanced storage or compute across nodes causes hot spots and reduced resilience. Monitoring skew supports rebalance and capacity planning.

useCases.title: HCI Data Resiliency and Rebuild Progress
useCases.value: After node or disk failure, rebuild must complete before another failure. Monitoring rebuild progress and ETA ensures data remains protected.

useCases.title: HCI Hypervisor and AOS Version Compliance
useCases.value: Mixed hypervisor or AOS versions can cause compatibility and support issues. Tracking version compliance supports upgrade planning and support eligibility.

useCases.title: HCI Network and Storage Controller Saturation
useCases.value: Saturated storage or network controllers cause latency and timeouts. Monitoring utilization supports capacity and design decisions.

useCases.title: HCI Prism Central and Management Plane Health
useCases.value: Prism Central (PC) failure affects visibility and automation. Monitoring PC and management plane ensures operations and alerting remain functional.

useCases.title: Dell VxRail Cluster Health
useCases.value: VxRail Manager health checks and LCM (Lifecycle Manager) update status directly impact cluster availability and supportability. Monitoring cluster and host health enables rapid response to hardware or software issues before they cause VM outages or failed upgrades.

useCases.title: Nutanix CVM Resource and Service Health
useCases.value: Deep-dive CVM CPU/memory pressure and Stargate latency vs UC-19.2.7 — for capacity and noisy-neighbor triage.

useCases.title: Storage Pool Rebalance Monitoring
useCases.value: Tracks Curator/Planned Outage rebalance and disk usage skew during rebalance operations on Nutanix/vSAN.

useCases.title: HCI Node Failure Domain Risk
useCases.value: Validates RF/FTM rules so critical VM replicas don’t share the same fault domain (rack/block) — risk scoring when domains are imbalanced.

useCases.title: vSAN Disk Group Health
useCases.value: Disk group mount state, component health, and checksum errors for VMware vSAN.

useCases.title: Cluster Expansion Events
useCases.value: Audits node add/remove, disk group expand, and maintenance mode during cluster scale events.

useCases.title: Nutanix AHV Host Capacity
useCases.value: vCPU, memory, and VM density headroom on AHV hosts — for right-sizing and new workload placement.

useCases.title: SimpliVity Backup Efficiency
useCases.value: Backup job success, dedupe ratio, and store utilization for HPE SimpliVity.

useCases.title: Azure Stack HCI Cluster Health
useCases.value: Cluster validation, storage pool health, and Azure Arc connection state for Azure Stack HCI.

useCases.title: HPE dHCI Tier Health
useCases.value: HPE disaggregated HCI storage tier latency, capacity, and replication lag between compute and storage.

useCases.title: vSAN Witness Appliance Health
useCases.value: Stretched vSAN witness availability and quorum for split-brain prevention.

useCases.title: HCI Deduplication Efficiency Ratio
useCases.value: Cluster-wide dedupe/compression ratio (Nutanix vs vSAN) vs baseline — efficiency regression indicates new noisy workloads or mis-tuned containers.

useCases.title: Nutanix Cluster Health Score and Critical Services
useCases.value: A single degraded critical service (Stargate, Cassandra, Curator) can silently erode I/O quality before user-visible alerts fire. Tracking cluster health score and service map together shortens time to stabilize the control plane.

useCases.title: VxRail LCM Compliance and Staged Bundle Drift
useCases.value: VxRail lifecycle compliance determines VMware and hardware driver supportability. Drift between staged bundles and installed release sets increases risk during one-click upgrades and delays security patching.

useCases.title: vSAN Disk Group Capacity Headroom and Mount State
useCases.value: Disk groups nearing full capacity slow resyncs and increase rebuild time, which extends windows of reduced fault tolerance. Monitoring per–disk group free space and mount state prevents surprise admission control during failures.

useCases.title: Nutanix Storage Pool Erasure Coding vs RF Footprint
useCases.value: Erasure coding reduces physical footprint but increases rebuild amplification on dense clusters. Tracking EC-enabled containers versus replication factor helps right-size policies and avoid capacity cliffs during failure events.

useCases.title: Nutanix Controller VM Storage Bandwidth Saturation
useCases.value: When CVM front-end bandwidth saturates, latency rises for every VM on the node regardless of guest CPU. Spotting sustained saturation drives rebalance, network uplink upgrades, or noisy-neighbor containment.

useCases.title: vSAN Component Overhead and Resync Backlog Depth
useCases.value: Deep component resync backlogs extend exposure after disk or host loss. Monitoring active resync bytes and component counts helps prioritize maintenance and throttle non-critical workloads until the cluster is healthy again.

useCases.title: Nutanix Async Remote Site Replication Lag and RPO Risk
useCases.value: Protection domain replication lag directly affects recovery point objectives for DR sites. Sustained lag beyond policy means a regional failure could lose more data than the business expects, and backlogs slow catch-up after link restoration.

useCases.title: VxRail vCenter Extension and Marvin Plugin Health
useCases.value: VxRail management extensions integrate cluster operations with vCenter. Plugin or API failures block LCM workflows and mask host issues from operators who rely on the VxRail UI.

app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services
useCases.title: Azure Stack HCI Cluster Validation and Quorum Health
useCases.value: Failed cluster validation or quorum issues can pause live migration and stretch failover. Centralizing validation results and witness reachability in Splunk reduces time to restore majority before a second fault impacts VMs.

app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services
useCases.title: Storage Spaces Direct Pool Utilization and Tier Imbalance
useCases.value: S2D pools that skew toward capacity tier without enough flash cache increase latency for tiered volumes. Tracking pool free space and cache/capacity ratio preserves predictable VM performance under burst workloads.

useCases.title: VM Placement and Live Migration Failure Rate
useCases.value: Failed live migrations strand VMs on stressed nodes and can interrupt maintenance. Trending Hyper-V migration failures by reason code highlights network, CSV, or CPU pressure before scheduled patching windows.

useCases.title: Azure Arc for Servers Heartbeat and Extension Inventory
useCases.value: Arc is the control path for Azure Policy, Update Management, and hybrid monitoring on HCI nodes. Stale heartbeats or missing extensions mean patches and guest configuration are not enforced, increasing security and uptime risk.

useCases.title: Windows Admin Center Connection and Gateway Audit Events
useCases.value: Windows Admin Center is often the break-glass console for HCI operations. Auditing gateway authentication failures and session spikes detects credential attacks or misconfigured smart-card rules before admins lose access during incidents.

useCases.title: Cluster-Aware Updating Run Status and Node Drain Failures
useCases.value: Failed CAU runs leave nodes partially patched or stuck outside maintenance mode, which breaks uniform firmware and OS compliance. Tracking per-node CAU stages surfaces stuck updates before the next failure domain event.

useCases.title: S2D Cache Device Health and Predictive Failure SMART Signals
useCases.value: Cache device loss on S2D sharply increases read latency and can stall resync. Surfacing predictive failure and wear indicators from physical disks lets you replace NVMe or SSD cache devices during business hours instead of during a double-fault scenario.

useCases.title: Daily Spend Trending
useCases.value: Cloud costs can spiral without visibility. Daily spend trending by service, account, and tag provides the financial governance foundation — enabling teams to understand where money goes, spot trends early, and make informed optimization decisions.

useCases.title: Cost Anomaly Detection
useCases.value: Unexpected cost spikes from runaway instances, misconfigured autoscaling, or crypto-mining attacks can generate thousands in charges within hours. Automated anomaly detection catches these events before they become budget disasters.

useCases.title: Reserved Instance Utilization
useCases.value: Reserved Instances and Savings Plans represent upfront commitments. Monitoring utilization ensures you're getting value from these purchases. Low utilization means wasted money; gaps in coverage mean missed savings opportunities.

useCases.title: Idle Resource Identification
useCases.value: Idle resources (running but unused instances, unattached volumes, unused load balancers) are pure waste. Identifying and eliminating them is the quickest path to cloud cost savings, often yielding 20-30% reduction.

useCases.title: Budget Threshold Alerting
useCases.value: Budget alerts prevent overspend by notifying stakeholders at defined thresholds (50%, 75%, 90%, 100%). Combined with forecast-based alerts, teams can take corrective action before exceeding approved budgets.

useCases.title: Cost Allocation by Team
useCases.value: Breaking down cloud costs by team/department via tagging creates accountability and enables chargeback/showback. Teams that see their own costs make better optimization decisions, driving organization-wide cost efficiency.

useCases.title: Spot/Preemptible Instance Tracking
useCases.value: Spot instances offer significant savings (60-90%) but can be interrupted. Tracking interruptions, savings achieved, and workload placement ensures teams maximize savings while maintaining application resilience.

useCases.title: Data Transfer Cost Analysis
useCases.value: Data transfer costs are often the most surprising cloud bill item. Inter-region, cross-AZ, and internet egress charges add up quickly. Identifying the biggest transfer flows enables architectural optimization to reduce costs significantly.

useCases.title: Predictive Disk / Volume Exhaustion
useCases.value: Time-to-full forecast using linear regression on disk usage data enables proactive capacity planning. Running out of disk space causes application outages, failed backups, and data loss. Predicting exhaustion dates allows teams to provision storage or archive data before hitting critical thresholds.

useCases.title: Reserved Instance Coverage Gaps
useCases.value: Highlights on-demand spend in families/regions that could be covered by additional RIs/Savings Plans — complements utilization of existing commitments (UC-20.1.3).

useCases.title: Spot Instance Interruption Rate
useCases.value: Interruptions per 1,000 instance-hours by pool and AZ — extends raw event counts (UC-20.1.7) with a **rate** for SLO tracking.

useCases.title: FinOps Budget Alert Correlation
useCases.value: Joins AWS Budgets / Azure budget notifications with resource change events and anomaly searches to explain **why** a threshold fired.

useCases.title: Cost Anomaly by Cloud Service
useCases.value: z-score or median-absolute-deviation of **daily cost per `lineItem_ProductCode`** — tighter scope than account-level UC-20.1.2.

useCases.title: Savings Plan Utilization and Hourly Burn
useCases.value: Savings Plan utilization % and unused commitment hours — operational view for FinOps reviews (related to UC-20.2.9).

useCases.title: Data Transfer Cost Attribution by Tag
useCases.value: Allocates data transfer line items to `resourceTags_user_*` for chargeback — extends aggregate transfer analysis (UC-20.1.8).

useCases.title: Container Workload Right-Sizing Cost
useCases.value: Correlates EKS/AKS/GKE namespace CPU/memory requests vs actuals with allocated node cost for rightsizing recommendations.

useCases.title: Serverless Invocation Cost Trending
useCases.value: Daily Lambda/Azure Functions/Google Cloud Functions cost and invocation count — detects runaway retries and bad deploys.

useCases.title: Orphaned Cloud Resource Detection
useCases.value: Unattached volumes, unused elastic IPs, old snapshots without volume — **inventory-driven** waste beyond idle CPU (UC-20.1.4).

useCases.title: Cost Allocation Tag Compliance
useCases.value: Percentage of monthly spend that is **untagged** or missing required keys (`Application`, `CostCenter`, `Environment`).

useCases.title: Idle Resource Identification by Account
useCases.value: Rolls up idle candidates (UC-20.1.4) to **account and owner** for FinOps accountability — same theme, executive view.

useCases.title: Azure Cost Management Daily Spend by Meter Category
useCases.value: Azure invoices spread spend across many meters (compute, storage, networking, PaaS). Rolling up daily cost by `MeterCategory` and subscription exposes the biggest budget drivers early so teams can tune SKUs, retire sandboxes, and negotiate reservations before month-end true-up.

useCases.title: GCP Billing Export Cost by Project and Service
useCases.value: Google Cloud bills aggregate credits, sustained-use discounts, and cross-project shared VPC egress. Tracking `project.id` and `service.description` daily highlights runaway BigQuery scan jobs, idle Composer environments, and forgotten projects that quietly consume committed spend.

useCases.title: Reserved Instance Purchase Amortization vs On-Demand Leakage
useCases.value: Amortized RI fees should displace on-demand box usage in the same instance family. When amortized reservation cost rises but matching usage stays on-demand, coverage or scope mismatches waste committed dollars. This view quantifies leakage for purchasing corrections.

useCases.title: Savings Plan Coverage of Eligible Compute Spend
useCases.value: Savings Plans discount compute only when usage is eligible and within the commitment’s scope. Low coverage means you are still paying list price for large portions of EC2, Fargate, or Lambda despite owning a plan—direct savings opportunity on the next purchase or exchange.

useCases.title: NAT Gateway and VPC Endpoint Egress Cost Concentration
useCases.value: Managed NAT and interface endpoints bill per GB processed; a single chatty microservice behind NAT can dominate networking spend. Ranking usage types tied to NAT Gateway and PrivateLink highlights candidates for VPC endpoint redesign, caching, or regional consolidation.

useCases.title: Spot Fleet Savings vs Interrupted Instance-Hours
useCases.value: Spot savings only matter if interruptions stay within SLOs. Correlating amortized spot spend with interruption counts from CloudTrail yields a simple dollars-saved-per-interruption metric so teams balance price and reliability across pools.

useCases.title: Cross-Cloud Consolidated FinOps Executive Rollup
useCases.value: Enterprises rarely have a single pane for AWS, Azure, and GCP together. Normalizing daily spend into `cloud_provider`, `business_unit`, and `currency` enables portfolio-level trending and board-ready variance explanations without manual spreadsheet merges.

useCases.title: Compute Capacity Forecasting
useCases.value: Running out of compute capacity causes provisioning failures and performance degradation. Forecasting when CPU and memory will be exhausted enables proactive procurement or scaling, avoiding emergency purchases at premium cost.

useCases.title: Storage Growth Forecasting
useCases.value: Storage procurement has lead times. Forecasting growth trends enables timely ordering of additional capacity, preventing the emergency of running out of storage space that causes application outages and data loss.

useCases.title: Network Bandwidth Trending
useCases.value: Network bandwidth constraints cause application latency and packet loss. Trending WAN/LAN utilization enables planned upgrades during maintenance windows rather than emergency bandwidth additions during business-impacting congestion.

useCases.title: License Utilization Tracking
useCases.value: Software licenses represent significant IT spend. Tracking usage vs entitlements identifies under-licensed risks (compliance violations) and over-licensed waste (unnecessary spend). Right-sizing licenses can save 15-30% of software costs.

useCases.title: Right-Sizing Recommendations
useCases.value: Over-provisioned VMs and instances waste compute and money. Right-sizing analysis compares actual resource usage against allocated resources, identifying instances that can be downsized without impacting performance — typically saving 20-40%.

useCases.title: Database Growth Projection
useCases.value: Databases that run out of space cause application outages. Forecasting database growth enables proactive storage expansion, archive planning, and helps DBAs plan maintenance windows for data lifecycle operations.

useCases.title: Seasonal Capacity Modeling
useCases.value: Many businesses have predictable seasonal patterns (retail holidays, fiscal year-end, enrollment periods). Building seasonal capacity models ensures infrastructure scales proactively for peak periods rather than reactively during customer-impacting events.

useCases.title: IP Address Space Utilization
useCases.value: IP address exhaustion causes provisioning failures for new VMs, containers, and services. Monitoring IP pool utilization across subnets and VLANs enables proactive network planning and avoids emergency re-addressing projects.

useCases.title: Cloud Commitment and Savings Plan Utilization
useCases.value: Underutilized commitments or savings plans leave money on the table. Monitoring utilization and coverage supports optimization and renewal decisions.

useCases.title: Anomalous Cost Spike by Service or Account
useCases.value: Sudden cost spikes may indicate runaway resources, misconfiguration, or abuse. Early detection limits bill shock and supports incident response.

useCases.title: Unused and Orphaned Resource Cost Attribution
useCases.value: Unused disks, idle instances, and orphaned snapshots drive waste. Attributing cost to these resources supports cleanup and chargeback.

useCases.title: License and Subscription Consumption vs Entitlement
useCases.value: Over-consumption causes true-up or compliance issues; under-consumption wastes spend. Monitoring usage vs entitlement supports optimization and renewal.

useCases.title: Cost Forecast vs Budget and Variance Alert
useCases.value: Forecast over budget risks overspend; large variance indicates model or usage change. Monitoring forecast vs budget supports proactive control and reforecasting.

useCases.title: Software License Compliance Audit
useCases.value: Software license consumption vs. purchased (VMware, Oracle, Microsoft, etc.) visibility prevents compliance violations and identifies over-licensed waste. Tracking concurrent usage against entitlements supports true-up planning and right-sizing at renewal.

useCases.title: Power Consumption Cost Trending
useCases.value: kWh to cost mapping for data center charge-back enables accurate cost allocation and energy efficiency tracking. Understanding power consumption trends supports capacity planning and identifies cost reduction opportunities.

useCases.title: Cloud Committed-Use Discount Coverage
useCases.value: Reserved instance and savings plan coverage percentage monitoring ensures committed-use discounts are utilized. Unused commitments waste money; gaps in coverage mean paying on-demand rates. Optimizing coverage typically saves 30–50% vs on-demand.

useCases.title: Storage Capacity Forecast by Tier
useCases.value: Forecast days-to-full per storage tier (flash vs capacity) — extends pool forecasting (UC-20.2.2) with **tier** dimension for procurement.

useCases.title: Compute Cluster Scaling Headroom
useCases.value: Remaining vCPU and RAM in VMware/vSphere clusters and AWS ASG max — for **provisioning headroom** beyond host forecast (UC-20.2.1).

useCases.title: Network Bandwidth Utilization Trending (Site Interconnect)
useCases.value: Site-to-site and DCI link utilization trend with 95th percentile — complements interface forecast (UC-20.2.3).

useCases.title: Seasonal Capacity Planning Baseline
useCases.value: YoY same-week CPU/RPS comparison for retail/event peaks — extends UC-20.2.7 with **automated peak week** flagging.

useCases.title: CPU and Memory Right-Sizing (Host and VM)
useCases.value: Host-level overcommit risk and VM-level downsize candidates — pairs with VM view (UC-20.2.5).

useCases.title: Disk IOPS Saturation Trending
useCases.value: Time-series of `iops_utilization_pct` or latency vs IOP limit for SAN/NVMe — storage performance bottleneck before capacity full.

useCases.title: VM Sprawl Detection
useCases.value: Count of powered-on VMs per app owner vs license and growth rate — finds unchecked provisioning.

app: Splunk Add-on for AWS / Azure / GCP
useCases.title: Cloud Cost Anomaly with Seasonal Decomposition (MLTK)
useCases.value: Cloud costs follow predictable weekly and monthly cycles — batch jobs on weekends, month-end reporting spikes, quarterly compliance scans. Static thresholds generate noise during normal peaks and miss slow-growth anomalies during quiet periods. By decomposing cost into seasonal, trend, and residual components with MLTK, this detection flags true anomalies against the expected cost shape for that specific day and hour.

useCases.title: Capacity Exhaustion Prediction with Confidence Intervals (MLTK)
useCases.value: Linear extrapolation of resource growth is dangerously simplistic — it misses seasonal acceleration, step changes from new workloads, and growth rate changes after migrations. Probabilistic forecasting with MLTK provides a range of exhaustion dates (best/expected/worst case) so capacity teams can plan procurement and migrations with appropriate urgency.

useCases.title: Kubernetes Namespace Resource Quota Pressure
useCases.value: Hard quotas stop deployments during peak traffic, causing revenue-impacting outages. Tracking requested versus hard limits for CPU, memory, and persistent volume claims per namespace lets platform teams expand quotas or reclaim unused requests before developers hit the wall.

useCases.title: Object Storage Bucket Growth Forecast
useCases.value: Object storage growth from logs, images, and backups drives recurring invoices. Forecasting gigabytes by bucket supports lifecycle policies, intelligent tiering, and archive capacity before ingest jobs fail.

useCases.title: Database Datafile Size and Autogrow Trending
useCases.value: SQL Server and Oracle datafiles that autogrow frequently signal unexpected data loads or missing archival. Trending file size and growth events avoids emergency disk extensions during month-end loads.

useCases.title: Site-to-Site VPN Tunnel Bandwidth Headroom
useCases.value: VPN tunnels to cloud and partners have fixed negotiated throughput. Sustained high utilization causes latency and drops during batch windows. Headroom reporting triggers circuit upgrades or traffic engineering before outages.

useCases.title: Search and Analytics Cluster Disk Watermark Risk
useCases.value: OpenSearch and Elasticsearch clusters stop indexing when disk watermarks are breached, breaking log and application pipelines. Tracking used shard store versus cluster capacity predicts when frozen tiers or data nodes must be added.

useCases.title: Message Broker Disk and Retention Capacity
useCases.value: Kafka retains messages on disk; retention growth from new microservices or poison-pill topics can fill brokers and halt producers. Monitoring log segment volume and free disk prevents cascading application failures.

useCases.title: GPU Pool Utilization for ML Workload Capacity
useCases.value: GPU nodes are expensive; low average utilization wastes capital while queue spikes delay training service levels. Tracking streaming-multiprocessor utilization and peak load by host informs autoscaler bounds and purchase versus spot decisions.

useCases.title: Domain Controller Performance Under LDAP Load
useCases.value: Authentication and directory search storms can saturate domain controllers before generic server CPU alerts explain the blast radius. Correlating directory operation rate with CPU utilization supports extra domain controllers, load balancing changes, and misbehaving application fixes.

useCases.title: SaaS License Utilization (Assigned vs Active)
useCases.value: Paying for assigned-but-unused seats wastes budget; comparing entitlements to real sign-in or activity highlights reclaim and right-size opportunities before renewals.

useCases.title: Software Audit Readiness Reporting
useCases.value: Audit-ready evidence of installs, purchases, and usage reduces true-up penalties and speeds vendor true-up negotiations.

useCases.title: Subscription Renewal Forecasting
useCases.value: Forecasting renewal cash-out dates and contract values avoids surprise budget hits and gives procurement time to negotiate or consolidate vendors.

useCases.title: License Compliance Gap Detection
useCases.value: Unlicensed use of enterprise software creates legal and financial exposure; continuous gap detection supports proactive remediation.

useCases.title: Multi-Year Contract Consumption Trending
useCases.value: Enterprise agreements with committed spend need burn-down tracking; falling behind consumption risks leaving value on the table, while overspending early risks true-up shocks.

useCases.title: License Pool Allocation Optimization
